Veim tomar: haya lo lomar kelalot shebbivchukkotay bilshon yachid velo haya tzarich lichpol kelalot ellu, shehayiti omer shello yaanish hakkatuv kol haonesh hechamur ella lichidim aval lichlalut yisrael lo, o hagam shennomar shechetam gadol venilmad meonesh hayyechidim en lanu havetachat hannechama sheyyizkor Adonai et berit haavot, talmud lomar kelalot shebbivchukkotay lomar sheggam hakkelalut yeanshu kaze, vechi yesh lahem nechama leval yafer Adonai berit avotenu veshav et shevutenu.

Nimtzenu omrim sheyyaanish Adonai al bittul talmud tora, veal haover al mitzvot lo taase veal hammevattel mitzvot ase. vahagam sheamru baggemara (menachot ma.) sheen maanishim al ase ella beiddan ritcha, yesh mitzvot ase shechayyavin alehem, kegon mila ufesach. gam hammaskim bedato lichpor bemitzvot ase leval asot otam – et ze yekallel Adonai vichinehu lefuranut kechol hakkatuv.

Vayyikra moshe el kol yisrael vegomer. hagam shead atta haya medabber el kol yisrael, hosif lekabbetz hannashim vehattaf vehaggerim, kaamur besamuch "attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem vegomer tappechem" vegomer (Devarim 29:9).
Chassalat parashat tavo

rashi: Baer hetev. beshivim lashon (sham 32):
Yalem. leshon aliyya:

Makke reehu bassater. al lashon hara hu omer; raiti visodo shel rabbi moshe haddarshan — 11 arurim yesh kan keneged 11 shevatim, ucheneged shimon lo chatav arur, lefi shello haya velibbo levarcho lifne moto keshebberech shear hashshevatim, lechach lo ratza lekallelo:
Yivtzor ruach. gassa shel nedivim, memaet gaavatam. yivtzor yemaet, kemo (Bereshit 11:6) "lo yibbatzer mehem":
targum: Yazer gasot ruchahon deravrevanaya dechila al kol malche ara:

rashi: Ele hatztzedek. leshon 'ilanot, kemo "meelim asher chamadtem" (Yeshayahu 1:9), umatta Adonai yore alav:
targum: Leshavaa laavele tzion lemittan lehon kelil chalaf ketam meshach dechedva chalaf evla ruach meshabbacha chalaf ruchahon dahavat amya veyikron lehon ravreve kusheta ame dayya leishtabbacha:

rashi: Ufittechu shearayich tamid. leshon 'pittuach, mimmishkolet lashon kaved, al shem sheppetichatan petichat olam, petichat tamid; kemo 'shibber milleshon 'shevira, kach milleshon 'peticha, 319 528 109:
targum: Veyitpattechun tarach tedira yemam velele la yitachadun laaala legavich nichse ammaya umalchehon zekikin:

rashi: Haseket. ketargumo:
Hayyom hazze nihyeta leam. bechol yom yihyu veenecha keillu hayyom bata immo babberit (berachot 63):
Lo achalti veoni mimmennu. mikkan sheasur leonen (80 Bikkurim 82 mishna 2):

Velo viarti mimmennu betame. ben sheani tame vehu tahor, ben sheani tahor vehu tame (sifre); vehechan huzhar al kach? "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha" (Devarim 12) zo achilat tuma, kemo shenneemar bifsule hammukdashim (sham 15) "bisharecha tochlennu hattame vehattahor vegomer", aval ze lo tuchal leechol derech achilat shearecha haamur bemakom acher (yevamot 73):
Velo natatti mimmennu lemet. laasot lo aron vetachrichin:
Shamati bekol Adonai elohay. haviotiv levet habbechira:
Asiti kechol asher tzivvitani. samachti vesimmachti vo (sifre; 710 85 12):
Asher lo yakim. kan kalal et kol hattora kullah vekibbeluha alehem beala uvishvua:
ohc: Arur asher lo yakim vegomer laasot vegomer. yesh bemashmaut hakkatuv shekkavvanato lomar al devarim haamurim bainyan, veyesh bemashmauto sheal kol hattora hu medabber, vechen pershuhu zichronam livracha (sota 37.). ledivrehem zichronam livracha taam amro "yakim laasot", sheim haya omer "asher lo yakim" levad o "asher lo yaase" lo hayta tekuma lesone yisrael, ki mi hu ze sheyyuchal lekayyem et divre hattora hazzot, uma gam mi sheen sippuk beyado lekayyem, kegon en lo sade lekayyem mitzvot hatteluyot bah o en lo eved lekayyem mitzvot hatteluyot bo. laze amar laasot, perush, sheeno bichlal arur ella mi shello yakim alav laasot keshettassig yado asot. velaze lo amar "asher lo yakim" o "asher lo yaase" ella "asher lo yakim laasot", perush, yakim belibbo haddevarim laasotam keshettassig yado.

rashi: Leshamma. kemo timmahon, 307 886, kol haroe otcha yishshom alecha:
Lemashal. keshettavo makka raa al adam yomru zo doma lemakkat peloni:
Velishnina. leshon "veshinnantam" (Devarim 6), yedabberu vecha, vechen targumo "uleshoe", leshon sippur veishtai:

ohc: Veanu chol haam veamru. velo hispik lomar "veamar kol haam" kederech sheamar bechol haarurim haamurim bainyan, heir Adonai barishona shetztzarich sheyyisrael yashivu ze, lo shehaleviyyim yitztarchu lomar "veamar kol haam", ella divre hakkatuv hu shemmetzavve sheyyaanu haam veyomru amen, veen al haleviyyim lomar "veamar kol haam" vegomer:

rashi: Barishona. kemo 'kevarishona, bime shelomo, keinyan shenneemar (Melachim 1 10:22): "ki oni tarshish lammelech bayyam achat leshalosh shanim tavo oni tarshish vegomer", tarshish shem hayyam:
Leshem Adonai elohayich. shennikra alecha, ki yishmeu shimo veshem gevurato veyavou:
Ki fearach. natan lach peer:
targum: Are lememri nagvan yesabberun venachate sefine yama ayda farsa kalaha vekadmeta leaytaa benach merachik kaspehon udehavhon imhon lishma dayya elahach ulekadisha deyisrael are shabbechach:

rashi: Kol nifleotecha. geulla haacharona sheshshekula keneged kol hannissim, kemo shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 16:14) "lo yeamer od chay Adonai asher heela vegomer":
targum: Ashabbach kodam Adonai bechol libbi eshtae kulehon perishvatach:

rashi: Yshegalenah. leshon shegal, pilegesh, vehakkatuv kinnahu leshevach yishkavenna, vetikkun sofrim hu ze:
Techallelennu. bashshana harviit leechol piryo (Megila 25):
Vechalot alehem. metzappot alehem sheyyashuvu veenam shavim; kol tochelet sheenah baa keruya kilyon enayim:
Massig gevul. machaziro laachorav vegonev et hakkarka, leshon "vehussag achor" (Yeshayahu 59):
Vehifla Adonai et makkotcha. muflaot umuvdalot mishshear makkot:
Veneemanot. leyassercha, lekayyem shelichutan:
ohc: Makkot gedolot veneemanot vocholayim raim veneemanim. amro neemanim nitkavven lomar shehagam sheyyaasu lahem refua tivit sheyyuseru bah, af al pi chen neemanim bishlichutam, mehem lo yazuu, ad bo devar Adonai lasur mimmennu.

rashi: Vehaya ki tavo … virishtah veyashavta bah. maggid shello nitchayyevu bevikkurim ad shekkavshu et haaretz vechillekuha (80 kiddushin 37 amud bet):
ohc: Vehaya ki tavo el haaretz. amar vehaya leshon simcha, lehair sheen lismoach ella bishivat haaretz, al derech amro (tehillim 126:2) "az yimmale sechok pinu" vegomer.

Asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala virishtah vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hi gezerat hakkatuv, im "velakachta" vegomer hava leh lememar "tikkach mereshit" kevan shehu hatechalat hatztziuuy. venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi sheyyetzav Adonai arba mitzvot: echad – sheyyeda belibbo ki lo bechocho velo beotzem gevurato ba lareshet haaretz ella mattat Adonai, vehu amro "asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha". vedikdek lomar Adonai elohecha lehair sheal menat sheyyekabbel elohuto alav hu noten. 2 – lehorish haaretz miyyoshveha, hagam sheyyesh lo davar hammaspik lo baaretz, af al pi chen yegaresh oyve Adonai meartzo, vehu amro virishtah. shelishit – yeshivat haaretz shehi mitzva bifne atzmah, kemo shemmatzinu kamma hifligu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (ketuvot ki.) bemitzvat yeshivat haaretz. reviit – havaat habbikkurim, keamro velakachta vegomer.

rashi: Ele nevayot. dichre nevayot:
targum: Kol an aravae yitkanshin legavich dichre nevayot yeshamshunich yittaskun leraava al madbechi uvet tushebachti ashabbech:

rashi: Lezaava. leema ulezia, sheyyazuu kol shome makkotecha mimmecha veyomru "oy lanu shello yavo alenu kederech shebba al ellu":
Asher yihye bayyamim hahem. en lecha ella kohen shebbeyamecha kemo shehu (rosh hashshana 25):
Veamarta elav. sheencha kefuy tova:
Higgadti hayyom. paam achat bashshana velo shete feamim (sifre):
ohc: Nishba vegomer latet lanu. lemaet hagger sheeno kore (bikkurim 1,4), velo miato ella bikria velo bahavaa.

rashi: Hayyom hazze Adonai elohecha metzavvecha. bechol yom yihyu veenecha chadashim keillu vo vayyom nitztavveta alehem (tanchuma):
Veshamarta veasita otam. bat kol mevarachto — heveta vikkurim hayyom, tizke leshana habbaa (sham):
ohc: Hayyom hazze vegomer. vechi hayyom hu metzavve, vahalo kevar tzivva behar sinay? verashi zichrono livracha peresh: bechol yom yihyu beenecha chadashim. venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi al ze hadderech, lefi shekkol hattora tzivva otah Adonai behar sinay, ben devarim sheyyesh bahem kum ase beoto zeman ben devarim sheenam bekum ase ella leachar zeman, keotam haamurim befarasha zot – bikkurim umaasrot sheenam nohagim ella baaretz, vetzivva Adonai otam hagam shello haya zemannam, mittaam kede lilmod otam ulekabbel sachar al kabbalatam. veamar lahem moshe ki hen hayyom metzavve otam laasot hachukkim haelle shehem bikkurim umaasrot, shead hayyom nitztauu lilmod dinehem levad, vehayyom hazze metzavve otam laasot ki higgiu laaretz. vetevat "hayyom" lav davka, ella zachar zeman hammuchan beshem "hayyom hazze".

rashi: Ashuk. bechol maasecha yihye irur:
Chayyecha teluim lecha. al hassafek, kol safek karuy taluy, shemma amut hayyom bacherev habbaa alenu. verabbotenu darshu ze hallokeach tevua min hashshuk:
Vela taamin bechayyecha. ze hassomech al happalter (80 menachot 103):
Bekum lammishpat elohim. laasot mishpat meoyvav, lehoshia chizkiyyahu vesiato:
targum: Amarin tzadikaya yekum ledina im rashiaya elaha lemifrak min yedehon kol invetane ara lealmin:

rashi: Uveshiva derachim yanusu lefanecha. ken derech hannivhalim livroach, mitpazzerin lechol tzad:

ohc: Yadbek Adonai vegomer. onesh ze ukelalot haamurot ad "veatta tihye lezanav", hem keneged bittul mitzvot lo taase, velaze gamar omer uvau alecha kol hakkelalot vegomer ki lo shamata bekol Adonai lishmor mitzvotav, hare shekkelalot haamurot bainyan hem al bittul mitzvot lo taase. vehammaskil yavin bechol hakkelalot shehem raot hannimshachot mehaaverot. veamro yadbek Adonai becha vegomer, lefi shehaover afillu avera achat kone lo chelek ra sheyyihye nidbak benafsho letammeah, vehu sod tachalue hannefesh kayyadua, vechelek hara nikra dever al derech amru zichronam livracha (tosfot shabbat 89. dibur hamatchil tora) befasuk (Chavakuk 3:5) "lefanav yelech daver", sheyyedabber al 100 harasha shennikra dever. veyadua shekkol kochot hara hem anafav shel 100 veyikkaru al shemo. gam killat shachefet vekaddachat vechulei hem devarim hamesubbavim mehaaverot, al derech amram baggemara (shabbat noah.) amar rabbi ame en mita belo chet veen yissurin belo avon, ki heavon yolid tachaluim bagguf keamro (yirmeya 2:19) "teyasserech raatech" vegomer.
Vechen amro vehayu shamecha vegomer, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 6:) shebbeemtzaut haaverot yistattemu pitche hahashpaot, besod (Iyov 14:11) "venahar yecherav veyavesh".

Vechen amro yittencha Adonai niggaf vegomer, gam ze yesovvu haaverot, karamuz befasuk (Kohelet 8,9) "asher yishlot haadam beadam lera lo", perush, lesibbat hara asher lo devuka bo, karamuz bemaamar "yadbek Adonai becha et haddaver", vechen kol hakkelalot haamurim bainyan yesubbevu mimmaase haraa.
Veamro "vehayu vecha leot ulemofet" (Devarim 28:46), ki haover avera achat nirshemet al mitzcho.

Veamro uvezaracha ad olam. ki nefesh adam ra al yede sheddevukim bah chelke hattuma kemo sheamarnu, benehem asher yolidu kemohem yihyu, kemo shebbearnu baer hetev davar ze befarashat vaychi befasuk "reuven bechori atta" (Bereshit 49:3). gam ze hu sod mita shennigzera al adam veal kol dorot habbaim mimmennu mittaam shekkol hayyotzim mimmennu taamu mavet becheto, vehu sod arlat adam. laze amar uvezaracha ad olam, ki kesheyyidbak chelek hara im haadam yishtalshel mizze laze ad olam, vetzarich otzem rav lenakkoto minnafsho.

rashi: Veshod melachim. leshon 'shadayim, vtinaki yore alav:
targum: Vetisbein nichse ammaya uvevizat malchin titpankin vetedin are ana Adonai parkich umeshezvich takifa deyaakov:

rashi: Veachalta … besar banecha … bematzor. mechamat sheyyihyu tzarim al hair veyihye sham matzok, akat reavon:
Veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha. hitvadde shennatatta maashrotecha:
Biarti hakkodesh min habbayit. ze maaser sheni veneta revai (sifre; 410 15) velimmedcha sheim shiha maasrotav shel shete shanim velo heelam lirushalayim shetztzarich lehaalotam achshav:
Vegam netattiv lallevi. maaser rishon: vegam. lerabbot teruma uvikkurim:
Velagger layyatom velaalmana. ze masar ani (sham):

Kechol mitzvatcha. netattim kesidram, lo hikdamti teruma levikkurim velo maaser litruma velo sheni larishon, shehatteruma keruya reshit, shehi rishona mishshenaasa dagan, uchetiv (Shemot 22) "meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher" — lo teshanne et hasseder (sifre):
Lo avarti mimmitzvotecha. lo hifrashti mimmin al sheeno mino umin hechadash al hayyashan (sham):
Velo shachachti. millevarechcha al haferashat maasrot (berachot 40):

Harach becha veheanog. hu harach hu heanog — leshon pinnuk, umehitanneg umeroch mochiach alehem sheshshenehem echad; aappi shehu mefunnak vedato katza bedavar maus, yimtak lo leraavono besar banav uvenotav, ad ki tera eno bevanav hannotarim mittet leechad mehem mibbesar banav achehem asher yochal. davar acher — harach becha, harachamani verach hallevav merov raavanut yitachzeru velo yittenu mibbesar benehem hashshechutim livnehem hannotarim:
Tera enah beish chekah uvivnah uvevittah. haggedolim:
Baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha. shettehe yetziatcha min haolam belo chet keviatcha laolam (42 107):
Shegar alafecha. valdot bekarcha, shehabbehema meshaggeret mimmeeha:
Veashterot tzonecha. ketargumo. verabbotenu amru lamma nikra shemam ashtarot? shemmaashirot et baalehen umachazikot otam keashtarot hallalu shehen selaim chazakim:

Alomut labben. yesh potrin al mut labben al met beno avshalom, velo yittachen pitrono mippene omer labben velo amar habben, veen lo bammizmor edut vezikkaron leammetz ze happitron. veyesh potrin al mut labben naval veaf ze lo yittachen lahafoch et hashshem veen bammizmor zichrono (sefer acher eno). veraiti bammesora haggedola shehi teva achat shehare chaver lah "vehu yenahagenu almut" (tehillim 48:15). patru menachem vedunash ma sheppetru veeno nire beenay. veraiti bifsikta shehainyan medabber baamalek gaarta goyim shimmam machita. veomer ani lamnatztzeach almut labben shir ze leatid lavo kesheyyitlabben yaldutan veshacharutan shel yisrael vetiggale tzidkatam vetikrav yeshuatam sheyyimmache amalek vezaro, alamot yaldut, labben kemo lelabben. umenachem patar almut labben, neginot lelammed, vecho pitrono lamnatztzeach al mut labben lamshorer neginot lelammed, vihi labben kemo lehavin ulevonen, almut al shem keli shir sheshshemo alamot kemo sheamar "al alamot shir" (tehillim 46:1). vedunash patar labben shem adam shehaya shemo labben shehaya nilcham bedavid bayyamim hahem, uma shehu omer gaarta goyim ibbadta rasha harasha hazze hu labben hahoreg am nekiyyim, veaf al pi sheen atta roe bemakom acher adam shehaya shemo labben rak bammakom hazze, ken atta motze bishmot acherim sheenan nichtavim bammikra rak paam achat:
targum: Leshabbacha al mitota degavra di nefak mibbene mashiryata tushebachta ledavid:

rashi: Shifat. rov:
Bichre midyan. "hogne midyan" (targum yonatan); hem gemallim bachurim, vechen "bichra kalla" (yirmeya 2:23):
Veefa. gam hem mibbene midyan, "efa vaefer" (Bereshit 25:4):
targum: Sheyaret arvae tachafe sacharanich hogne midyan veholad kulehon mishva yetun dehav ulevona yehon teinin udeatan imhon betushebachta dayya yehon mishtean:

rashi: Asher yagorta mippenehem. mippene hammakkot. keshehayu yisrael roin makkot meshunnot habbaot al mitzrayim, hayu yereim mehem shello yavou gam alehem. teda shekken katuv "im shamoa tishma vegomer kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha" (Shemot 15) — en meyarin et haadam ella bedavar shehu yagor mimmennu:
Baruch tanacha. perotecha; davar acher — tanacha davar lach sheatta mesannen besallim:
Umishartecha. davar yavesh shennishar bakkeli veeno zav:
Yihyu. haavonot haelle neged Adonai tamid:
Veyachret meeretz zichram. shel esav veallufav:
targum: Yehevyan kovel memra dayya tedira vishetze meara dachranhon:

rashi: Booniyyot. bisfinot — bashshivya:
Vehitmakkartem sham leoyvecha. attem mevakshim lihyot nimkarim lahem laavadim velishfachot:
Veen kone. ki yigzeru alecha hereg vechillayon:
Vehitmakkartem. belaaz 663 312, velo yittachen lefaresh "vehitmakkartem" bilshon venimkartem al yede mochrim acherim mippene shenneemar acharav "veen kone":
Lehitpaer. sheehye mitpaer bam, 567 109:
targum: Veamich kulehon zakkain laalam yachsenun ara nitzva dechedvati ovad gevureti leishtabbacha:

rashi: Velo natan Adonai lachem lev ladaat. lehakkir et chasde hakkabba veliddabbek bo:

Ad hayyom hazze. shamati sheoto hayyom shennatan moshe sefer hattora livne levi, kemo shekkatuv (Devarim 31) "vayyittenah el hakkohanim bene levi", bau chol yisrael lifne moshe veamru lo moshe rabbenu, af anu amadnu vesinay vekibbalnu et hattora venittena lanu, uma atta mashlit et bene shivtecha aleha veyomru lanu yom machar lo lachem nittena, lanu nittena, vesamach moshe al haddavar, veal zot amar lahem "hayyom hazze nihyeta leam vegomer", hayyom hazze hevanti sheattem devekim vachafetzim bammakom:
Ken yasis Adonai. et oyvechem alechem lehaavid vegomer:
Venissachtem. leshon akira vechen (Mishlei 15) "bet geim yissach Adonai":
Uvetimhon levav. otem hallev, ashetaveradeyshevan belaaz:
Makle aviv. mezalzel, leshon "venikla achicha" (Devarim 25):
ohc: Arur makle vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo bachar mikkol haaverot lomar alehem haarurim ella ellu. gam baarayot lamma lo yiched haarurim ella leellu, vahalo yesh arayot chamurim keellu vehem habba al eshet ish.

Veulay ki lo amar kan ella haaverot hattemunim vehannistarim, velaze rasham barishona veamar vesam bassater ki haose bederech sheyyihye mitgalle hinne nitchayyevu yisrael bearvut ze al ze. vechen ma sheamar arur makle perush sheyyaase lo kalon bederech sheeno nitpas alav bevet din shel matta. vechen hassagat gevul hu davar sheeno nikkar. vechen mashge ivver badderech en roe. vechen hattayat mishpat hashshefalim. vechen habba al eshet aviv veal habbehema veal achoto vechotanto, kullam en hergesh lezulat himmatzo immahem lachkor bo. vechen makke reehu dikdek lomar bassater. vechen lokeach shochad vegomer, kegon shehayu bet din shakul uva echad vehichria bisvarato bishvil shochad, gam ze hu middevarim hammesurim lallev veen hergesh lazzulat.
Vetaam shekkatav arur shochev im behema ben eshet aviv laachoto, lomar ki kol kach meruchak haddavar shel eshet av veachot keshochev im behema shehu davar zar umetoav leteva enoshi:

rashi: Uvirtzoni. uvehartzoti lach, 108 206 109:
targum: Veyivnon bene ammaya shurach umalchehon yeshamshunich are verugezi alketich uviruti arachem alach:

rashi: Kaasher dibber lach. vihyitem li segulla:
ohc: VaAdonai heemircha vegomer. amro lihyot lo leam segulla, shehagam shettavo umma acheret vetetiv maaseha vetishtaddel lehiddavek bashshechina – lo yassigu madregat yisrael, uvechina zo tikkare segulla vezo hi gedullatam. veamro kaasher dibber lach, bemaase har sinay dichtiv (Shemot 19:5) "vihyitem li segulla mikkol haammim":

O yirtze shehagam sheyyihye zeman sheyyachisu yisrael et habbore, af al pi chen lo yamir otam beumma acheret. veamro kaasher dibber, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 7.) befasuk (Shemot 33:16) "veniflinu ani veammecha", shebbikkesh moshe meAdonai shello yashre shechinato al haummot, uferashnuhu bimkomo (chafetz Adonai) shehakkavvana hi hagam shettachshir maaseha umma meummot veyisrael ovre retzono, vehiskim Adonai vedibber laasot kedivre moshe.

Velishmor kol mitzvotav. yesh lehair baddavar, halo davar ze hu mittenae hakkavod sherasham bemaase yisrael laAdonai kemo shekkatuv bappasuk "et Adonai heemarta", uma makom lehazekiro baddevarim shemme leyisrael?

Veulay ki tiferet yisrael hi ma sheheela veromem otam betet lahem kol hammitzvot, ma shello asa chen larishonim, shehagam shennatan mitzvotav yitbarach leadam ulenoach ulehaavot, lo natan ella shenayim shelosha gargerim, aval leyisrael natan shemirat kol mitzvotav yitbarach. veyesh lecha ladaat ki chol hammitzvot enam ella shemira mehatteuv umillichluch hannefesh, uvehashlamat shemirat hammitzvot yihye haadam shalem mikkol mum umikkol lichluch.

2) Yirtze ki Adonai yechazzek zeroot lishmor kol hammitzvot, ki lo hakkol zochim ledavar ze, hagam sheyyachpetzu lishmor lo yizdammen leyadam, veim yizdammen lo tassig yadam, veim tassig lechelek mehammitzvot lo tassig lechol hammitzvot, veamar kan ki Adonai heemiram lishmor kol mitzvotav.

3) Yirtze al derech amro (Kohelet 8:5) "shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra", veamru zichronam livracha (fesachim 8:) sheluche mitzva enam nizzokin, vehu maamar hakkatuv kan velishmor, perush, Adonai yishmor kol mitzvotav leval yetze mehem devar takkala.

4( Yirtze lehairam bedavar shello hissigo moshe atzmo alav hashshalom, hagam heyoto bichlal am segulla, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota yad.) beinyan tefillat moshe likkanes laaretz: vechi leechol mipperoteha vegomer? ella amar moshe: yesh harebe mitzvot shetteluyot baaretz vechulei, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven lomar lahem: reu maalatchem she heemir etchem vegomer velishmor kol mitzvotav, velaze dikdek lomar heemircha hayyom, perush, bizman ze sheattem baim el haaretz vesham tishmeru kol hammitzvot, vezo maala shello hissigah afilu moshe.

Vehinne timtza shesh maalot bappasuk et Adonai heemarta: 1 – lihyot lecha lelohim, 2 – lalechet bidrachav, 3 – lishmor chukkav, 4 – umitzvotav, Adonai – umishpatav, 6 – velishmoa bekolo. kenegdam amar Adonai shesh maalot lichneset yisrael: 1 – lihyot lo leam segulla, ze keneged lihyot lecha lelohim, 2 – velishmor kol mitzvotav, ze keneged lalechet bidrachav, 3, 4 vaAdonai – uletittecha elyon vegomer lithilla uleshem uletifaret, hem keneged shemirat chukkav umitzvotav umishpatav, 6 – velihyotcha am kadosh laAdonai, ze keneged velishmoa bekolo, ki al yede esek hattora yityaches lahem shem ze shel kadosh. veamro kaasher dibber, dichtiv (Shemot 19:6): "veattem tihyu li vegomer vegoy kadosh, elle haddevarim asher tedabber el bene yisrael".

rashi: Lo yihye lach od. lo titztarchi leor hashshemesh:
targum: La titztarchin lenehur shimsha bimama veaf la lezehur sihara belelya vihe lich Adonai lenehor alam veelhach letushebachtich:

rashi: Babboker tomar mi yitten erev. veyihye haerev shel emesh:
Uvaerev tomar mi yitten boker. shel shacharit, shehatztzarot mitchazzekot tamid vechol shaa merubba killatah mishshellefaneha (80 sota 49):
Shir chadash. mizmor ze al heatid, vesofo mochiach ki va lishpot et haaretz. bechol makom shir chadash al heatid:
targum: Shabbachu kodam Adonai tushebachta chadta shabbachu angele meroma shabbachu kodam Adonai kol tzadike ara:

rashi: Lo yeasef. leshon "asfu nagham" (Yoel 2:10), hichnisu oram:
targum: La tevatel od malchutich vikarich la yedi are Adonai yehe lich lenehor alam veyishlemun yome evlayich:

rashi: Lo targia. lo tanuach, kemo "vezot hammargea" (Yeshayahu 28):
Lev raggaz. lev chared, ketargumo "dachel", kemo (Yeshayahu 14) "sheol mittachat ragza lach" (Shemot 15) "shamu ammim yirgazun", (Shmuel 2 22) "mosdot hashshamayim yirgazu":
Vechilyon enayim. metzappe lishua velo tavo:
Veanita. leshon haramat kol (sota 32):

Arammi oved avi. mazkir chasde hammakom, arammi oved avi — lavan bikkesh laakor et hakkol kesheradaf achar yaakov, uvishvil shechashav laasot chashav lo hammakom keillu asa, sheummot haolam choshev lahem hakkabba machashava kemaase (80 sifre):
Vayyered mitzrayma. veod acherim bau alenu lechallotenu, sheachare zot yarad yaakov lemitzrayim:
Bimte meat. beshivim nefesh (sifre):
ohc: (1-11) Veanita veamarta. amar veanita, yesh mefarshim leshon hatechala, uchemo (Iyov 3:2) "vayyaan iyyov", veefshar shehu oni, keadam pachut shekkibbel tova gedola mimmelech shemmaani atzmo lefanav belev nishbar, kemo chen hu yachnia atzmo lifne Adonai, veyomar "arammi oved avi", ki avinu haya oved vetoe vegole bemitzrayim bimte meat vegomer, vayyotzienu Adonai mimmitzrayim vayvienu vegomer. ucheneged maamar ze sheyyesh bo illuy vachashivut amar veamarta, vechayyotze baze amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (fesachim 116:) beinyan haggadat pesach matchil bignut umesayyem bishvach.

Vehitztzatzti befarasha zo sheromezet gam ken biat eretz haelyona, veamar vehaya ki tavo sheen rauy laadam lismoach ella kesheyyavo laaretz haelyona, al derech amro (Mishlei 31:25) "vattischak leyom acharon", ki simchat olam hazze enah ella hevel ureut ruach. vechazar uferesh al eze eretz medabber, veamar asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala ki lazo yikkare nachalat olam, vedikdek lomar noten lecha, ki beerech ma sheshshave olam haelyon kol ma sheyyesaggel adam baado lo yaggia lechelek meelef alafim mishshavyo. velaze amar "noten lecha" betorat mattana. uletzad shetztzarich haadam litroach baolam hazze lekayyem tora umitzvot lezot amar "virishtah".
Veamar "veyashavta bah" – al derech amram (berachot la:) tzaddikim yoshvim veatrotehem berashehem.

Veamro velakachta vegomer, al derech amram besefer hazzohar (chelek 2 59.) ki chol asher yaase haadam mehammitzvot umaasim tovim beodo chay mitkabbetz al yad al yad ad yom nesiato, uvahem mekabbel pene hammelech, kederech amro (Yeshayahu 58,8) "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha", vehu amro velakachta mereshit kol peri vegomer, perush, lo yikkach beyado lehakebil pene Adonai ella middevarim hammuvcharim sheasa baolam hazze. od ramaz el hattora shennikret reshit (Bereshit Rabba 1:1).

Veamro asher Adonai elohecha noten lach yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot la.): ketiv "laAdonai haaretz umeloah" (tehillim 24:1) uchetiv "vehaaretz natan livne adam" (tehillim 115:16), lo kashya, kan kodem beracha kan leachar beracha, ad kan. hare sheachar sheyyaase haadam ma shetztzivvahu Adonai, nechshav haddavar shebbeemtzauto asa hammaase shehu natun lo bemattana, shezzulat ze kol maase haadam en lanu bo yitron ki lefi shemmifalo kullo hu beemtzaut olam shehu bo vela haaretz umeloah, laze amar "asher Adonai elohecha noten lach".

Veamro vesamta vattene. yirmoz shetztzarich kol mifalot hattovot sheasa yihyu al pi divrehem, keamro (Devarim 17:11) "al pi hattora asher yorucha veal hammishpat" vegomer, vehattora vehammishpatim bearu otam chachamim beshishshim massechtot keminyan tene, shezzulat ze hagam sheyyaase kol mitzvot shebbaolam yissaref hu vehem.

Veamro vehalachta el hammakom vegomer, lefi shebbaaliyyat hannefesh laolam haelyon lo telech techef umiyyad lehakebil pene Adonai, ad sheyyachin atzmo bapperozdor, veyesh shemmitakkevim ad shiva yamim, o chodesh, o yamim, kaamur besefer hazzohar (chelek 1 81.), veachar kach ole legan eden haelyon hannikra tzeror hachayyim, vehu hammakom asher yivchar Adonai leshakken shemo sham.

Veamro uvata el hakkohen. al derech amram zichronam livracha (chagiga 12:) ki michael omed lechahen lifne Adonai lehakeriv hannefashot lifne elohe olam, veelav yomar kaddevarim haelle "higgadti hayyom" vegomer.

Veamro asher yihye bayyamim hahem yitbaer al pi divrehem sheamru sheyyishtanne hakkohen haomed sham. tze ulemad ma sheamru bezohar chadash (parashat lecha lecha daf lod) beinyan michael, ematay zacha lihyot bematztzav ze, shehu meet sheheela nafsho shel david legan eden haelyon achar shebbana shelomo bet hammikdash vechulei. hare shellifamim yishtanne hakkohen, laze amar "asher yihye bayyamim hahem". veamarta elav higgadti hayyom laAdonai ki vati el haaretz hi eretz shemmimmenna ba, veamar nishba Adonai latet lanu hi eretz yisrael shebbeemtzautah yassigu kiyyum hattora umitzvot umaasim tovim.
Veamru velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha, perush, shello yekabbel sar elyon ella habba beyado meyussad al divre tora shebbeal pe haramuz betevat tene kemo shekkatavnu, "vehinnicho lifne" vegomer.

Veanita veamarta vegomer. perush, lefi shekkol asher yaase haadam mehattovot baolam hazze en day leratztzot melech elyon. tze ulemad mimma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (eruvin 17.) im yavo bemishpat im avraham yitzchak veyaakov enan yecholin laamod lefanav, ki ma yitzdak enosh. uchetiv (Iyov 4:17) "im meosehu yithar gaver", laze amra tora sheyyitten teshuva laAdonai vehitnatztzelut al asher lo asa retzono yitbarach kammitztarech, vehu amro veanita veamarta lifne Adonai arammi oved avi. arammi ze yetzer hara shehu rammay gadol, keamro (Bereshit 3:1) "vehannachash haya arum", shemmeramme habberiyyot leabbedam. vehu amro oved avi, perush adam harishon, al derech amro (Yeshayahu 43:27) "avicha harishon chata", veibbedo vegaram mita lo veladdorot habbaim acharav, vehishrish bechol hannefashot chelek hara, vehu sod arla haddevuka baadam mibbeten umeherayon. od yirtze beamro oved avi al derech amro (tehillim 14:1) "amar naval belibbo en elohim".

Od yirtze beamro avi, shehi hanneshama, shekkol moatzotav shel hassatan leabbed hanneshama. vehanneshama nikret av, keamram bazzohar parashat lech lecha (76.), vehu hu hammonea haadam measot chiyyuvo baavodat Adonai. velo zo bilvad, ella "vayyered mitzrayma" – perush hammakom shebba bo hayyetzer, shehu gufo shel adam, hu metzerav shel hayyetzer hakkerovim elav, besod (Yeshayahu 65,25) "venachash afar lachmo", vachafetzim baasher yachpotz middivre olam hazze umatammav asher hitiv Adonai, ki arbaa yesodot shebbo hen hayyom achar chet haadam nigshemu venitmeu, shellesibba zo gazar Adonai mita lehaadam. uvaze nishmaim devarav ufittuyav lisode haadam. gam yikkare hagguf mitzrayim lefi shemmetzer lannefesh betaavotav.
Veamro vayyagar sham, ki battechilla nichnas keger, keamro (Shmuel 2 12:4) "vayyavo helech" vegomer (socha nov:).

Bimte meat perush bechochot muatim, veachar kach mitrabbim kochotav al yede haadam atzmo, vehu amro vayhi sham legoy gadol atzum, varav besod (tehillim 25:11) "vesalachta laavoni ki rav hu", uferesh harav haari zichrono livracha shechozer el hammefatte ki rav hu, veharaya shetztzivva Adonai beyom hakkippurim goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazel (Vayikra 16:8).

Veamro "vayyareu otanu hammitzrim" vegomer. perush, shebbeemtzaut yesodot haadam garmu gam lannefesh lehareshia kemotam, vehu amro vayyareu otanu – perush, asu otanu raim kemotam, ki hammezeg kesheyyasriach yimshoch elav retzon hannefesh.

Veamro vayannunu – ze afisat koach hallochem keneged hayyetzer hara. tze ulemad mimmaase rav amram chasida (kiddushin 81.) shello haya bo koach lehitatztzem keneged hammachati ad shekkara "nura be amram" vechulei.

Veamro vayyittenu alenu avoda kasha, perush, shello nahag hayyetzer bederech ze beittim meruchakim, ella tamid bechol shaa uvechol rega mitgabber al haadam, velazo yikkare avoda kasha. od nitkavven al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (kiddushin 30:) sheamru bechol yom mitchaddesh hayyetzer al haadam betigboret chadash, ucheneged ze amar avoda kasha. kol elle haddevarim yomar eved yisrael lifne habbore lehitnatztzel al mincha ketanna.

Veamro "vannitzak el Adonai" – kan ramaz shetztzarich haadam lehitpallel laAdonai bechol yom sheyyatztzilehu miyyetzer hara, vehu amro "vannitzak el Adonai" vegomer, veamro "vayyishma Adonai et kolenu" vegomer – perush, hagam she hu shebbara yetzer hara livchon haadam baavodat boro, af al pi chen keshetztzoakim elav shomea kolam, mittaam sheraa et harashum shehu anyenu vaamalenu velachatzenu. haoni hu afisat koach hallochem, sheen koach banu hammaspik lehillachem bo legarsho mimmennu; heamal hu sheanu tzerichin laamol bemilchamto; hallachatz hu haddochak sheddochek hayyetzer et haadam lachato beal karcho, uleshalosh sibbot shama Adonai et kolenu. od yirtze "anyenu" – ze haaniyyut hannisbach im lomde tora, keamram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim 5) sheamra tora mippene ma banay aniyyim, vahagam sheyyimmatze ben tora sheen shevet oni alav, af al pi chen yitnaheg bemiddat oni, keamram (avot 86) kach hi darkah shel tora vegomer. "veet amalenu" – al derech amram (berachot 17.) ashre mi sheamalo battora vegomer, uma gam baddorot haacharonim sherav amalah lehotzi laor mishpat echad vahalacha achat. "veet lachatzenu" – ki chol hannismach lattora rabbu lochatzav veene chol elav yesabberu.

Veamro vayyotzienu Adonai mimmitzrayim. zo hatztzalat yetzer hara vechochotav hammetzerim otanu, ki hu hammatztzil miyyetzer hara, keamram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 30:) shellule she ozer laadam keneged yetzer hara en adam shallit lehinnatzel mimmennu, dichtiv "tzofe rasha" – ze yetzer hara – "latztzaddik lahamito, Adonai lo yaazvennu veyado" (tehillim 37:32).

Veamro beyad chazaka vegomer, ramaz laddevarim shebbeemtzautam yatztzilehu Adonai vechulei, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 30:) amar hakkadosh baruch hu barati lachem yetzer hara barati lo tavlin shehi hattora, vehu amro vayyotzienu Adonai vegomer, beyad chazaka zo tora shennittena mimino shel hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv (Devarim 33:2) "mimino esh dat lamo", gam nittena bigvurot mittoch haesh.

Veamro uvizroa netuya vegomer, ramaz lishlosha devarim shebbeemtzautam nitztzol adam miyyetzer hara, keamram zichronam livracha (menachot mag:) kol mi sheyyesh lo tefillin bizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umezuza befitcho lo bimhera hu chote. keneged tefillin bizroo amar uvizroa netuya shemmitzvat tefillin bazzeroa, veamar uvemora gadol keneged tefillin shel rosh. ucheneged tzitzit amar uveotot ki mitzvat tzitzit hu siman lanu sheanu avde hakkadosh baruch hu, uchemo shepperashnu befarashat tzitzit (Bamidbar 15:37), gam tikkare chen beremez hattechelet, shebbo kemo shekkatav ramban (Bamidbar 15:38) sheromez el midda hakkolelet shennikra otot. ucheneged hammezuza amar uvemoftim kemashmaah, gam tikkare hammezuza mofet lihyotah mofet lazuz mavet miyyisrael, keamram besefer hazzohar (Zohar 11 265.) shekkamma kittot hakkelippot nirtaim birotam shem shadday al petach bet yisrael.

Od efshar shekkol hakkatuv yirmoz el hattora shebbah yinnatzel adam miyyetzer hara umittaavot olam hazze, veamar chamishsha inyanim keneged chamishsha chumeshe tora: beyad chazaka keneged sefer bereshit, ki sham neemar maase yede yotzer asher konnu yadav olam umeloo; veamar uvizroa netuya keneged sefer shemot, ki vo chasaf et zeroo vehera gevurotav bemaase mitzrayim uvayyam uvintinat hattora; veamar uvemora gadol keneged vayyikra, ki sham tzivva maase [avodat] hammishkan ushechunat shechinato vetzivva al mora hammakom vekiddesh habbayit bishne gedole yisrael, velaze yiches lesefer ze mora gadol; veamar uveotot keneged sefer chumash happekudim al shem (Bamidbar 2:2) "ish al diglo veotot"; veamar uvemoftim keneged sefer devarim, ki vo dibber moshe el kol yisrael vehochiach bemoftim al pachazutam veal tuv Adonai vechasdo immahem, vehochiach ki lo shillem Adonai lahem kemaasehem haraim vegavar alehem chasdo, gam bo neemar mofte hanneviim shebbahem yatzdiku hannavi.

Veamro vayvienu el hammakom hazze medabber al olam haelyon shehanneshama bo, vehinne en hanneshama maggaat ledabber kol haddevarim haelle ella achar aliyyatah laolam haelyon shennikra gan eden shel mala, achar shekkevar sava yamim began eden shellematta, velaze keneged amidatah lifne Adonai ledabber haddevarim haellu omer vayvienu el hammakom hazze, ki amidat hannefesh sham levad yesh lah bo shaashua gadol, ucheneged gan eden shellematta shekkevar zacha bo amar vayyitten lanu et haaretz hazzot eretz zavat chalav udevash, al derech amro (Shir HaShirim 4:11) "devash vechalav tachat leshonech".

Veamro veatta hinne. perush amro "veatta" leshon teshuva, sheshshav lifne Adonai al perate dikduke hammitzvot, vahagam shehakkatuv medabber bemi shekkevar zacha began eden shellematta, af al pi chen kede lizkot legader elyon yedakdeku alav beyoter. vehu sod hammishpat sheyyishpot Adonai leatid lavo beemek yehoshafat (midrash tehillim 8), shemmimmennu pachad verahav shemuel kesheheelattu baalat ov (chagiga 4:).
Veamro hinne heveti et reshit vegomer asher natatta li. kemo shepperashti lemala bemaamar "asher Adonai elohecha noten lach".

Veamro vehishtachavita lifne Adonai. baze heir ruach chayyim battova hammuflaa baedut hammuflag asher yizku elav hatztzaddikim, vehu shettitkarev nefesh hatztzaddik lifne or hanneerav vetishtachave lefanav been masach mavdil, ashre nefesh adam shettaggia legader muflag kaze, vehu amro vehishtachavita lifne Adonai elohecha sham takkir hannefesh eloheha.

Veamar samuch laze vesamachta bechol hattov, al derech amro (tehillim kama,9) "tov Adonai", ulehaircha al ze amar "bechol hattov", perush davar hakkolel kol hattov, veen ze ella hakkadosh baruch hu shehu mekor hattov, asher natan lecha perush ki davar ze en erech elav ella mattenat chinnam.

Veamar lecha, lishlol zulato, lo malach velo saraf yizke laze. gam yirmoz bemaamar bechol hattov el hattora, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 5.): veen tov ella tora, sheim hayu bene adam margishin bimtikut vaarevut tuv hattora hayu mishtaggeim umitlahatim achareha, velo yechashev beenehem melo olam kesef vezahav limuma ki hattora kolelet kol hattovot shebbaolam:
Veamro ulevetecha. ki lo lanneshama levad yaggia hattov, ella gam levet hanneshama shehi ruach venefesh shehem mishkan hanneshama, kol echad yitadden kefi yechalto.

Veamro vehallevi. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru bazzohar (chelek 2 94.) veze leshonam: zacha yattir yahavin leh nishmeta vechulei, zacha yattir yahavin leh nishmeta meor atzilut" vechulei ad kan. velivchina zo yikra hakkatuv levi, lefi shemmitlavva im haadam mechadash.

Veamro vehagger. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 3 217.) sheamru ki kesheyyaggia leyad adam mitzva meotam mitzvot sheenam nohagot tamid, otam hanneshamot shekkevar nistalleku mehaolam vehem chasere mitzva zo, baim vegarim im haose hammitzva al ze hadderech, kerovim lassachar urechokim min hahefsed, kaamur beorech bedivre hammekubbalim, ucheneged bechina zo amar vehagger asher bekirbecha.

rashi: Velihyotcha am kadosh … kaasher dibber. vihyitem li kedoshim (Shemot 20, 26):

ohc: (9-11) Yekimcha Adonai vegomer. mikkan ad "yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov" hu yiud hattov shekkeneged shemirat mitzvot lo taase sherasham betevat "lishmor", vehu ma sheggamar omer ki tishmor et mitzvot Adonai. veamro vehalachta bidrachav lomar shello tzivva Adonai ella al haddevarim shehu merachakam. veyiud ze mechuvvan hu keneged shemirat mitzvot lo taase, ki beemtzaut sheyyihye haadam nishmar mehaaverot yikkare kadosh, dichtiv "kedoshim tihyu", uferush hakkatuv haddevarim shebbahem yihyu kedoshim: "ish immo vegomer veet shabbetotay vegomer al tifnu el" vegomer ushear azharot haamurim. vegam ledivre chachamenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 24,6) sheal azharat haarayot neemar "kedoshim", hinne hi bichlal lishmor. velaze amar keneged shemirat mitzvot lo taase "yekimcha Adonai lo leam kadosh". vedikdek lomar tevat lo lehair sheyyihyu yisrael bimkom hammalachim shebberar Adonai lo laamod lefanav, shennikraim kedoshim, dichtiv (Daniel 8:13) "vayyomer echad kadosh". yakim Adonai otanu bimkomam leam kadosh veyihyu hammalachim shirayim lahem, vechen amar (Bamidbar 23:23) "kaet yeamer leyaakov" vegomer (Bamidbar Rabba 20,20).

Veamro "verau kol amme haaretz" vegomer, gam ze hu mechuvvan keneged shemirat mitzvot lo taase, ki kol zeman shehaadam shomer atzmo mehaaverot en tzelem elohim over meal panav, vechol hannivraim adam uvehema mizdazeim mimmennu, ma sheen ken hammetaev maasav maavirin mimmennu hatztzelem, uchemaamar kayin (Bereshit 4:14) "vehaya chol motzi" vegomer:

Vehotircha Adonai letova bifri vitnecha. hagam shekkevar amar lemala "baruch peri vitnecha", lefi sheyyiud harishon hu keneged talmud tora veyiud ze hu keneged shemirat hammitzvot, laze hutzrach lefaret sechar kol echad, sheen echad nilmad mechavero. vedikdek lomar vehotircha Adonai letova velo amar "baruch peri vitnecha", lefi sheyyiud ze hu midda tova shemmechuvvenet keneged shemirat mitzvot lo taase, vehakkavvana hi ki lefi shebbeemtzaut shemirat haadam atzmo mehaaverot lo yidbeku bo koche hara, shemmizze yesubbav shehabbanim hayyotzim mimmennu yihyu mibbechinat hara, veayyen ma shekkatavnu beorech befarashat vaychi befasuk "reuven bechori atta" (Bereshit 49:3) veyeervu lecha haddevarim. laze amar beyiud shemirat mitzvot lo taase vehotircha Adonai letova bifri vitnecha sheyyihyu habbanim hannotarim acharecha lemidda tova velo lemidda raa.
Veamro bifri vehemtecha uvifri admatcha, lomar shemmitztzad shemirat mitzvot lo taase yitkayyemu beyado shene devarim ellu, kemo sheyyeadam lischar talmud tora kakkatuv lemala.

Veanu haleviyyim. perush – vehitchilu, shehem yatchilu ledabber vehaam yaanu acharehem amen. veuneklos tirgem "veyativun", velidvarav "veanu haleviyyim" teshuva lehaamadat yisrael beseder ze al heharim, shehu lehashemiam amarot haamurot mippihem "baruch asher" vegomer vearur asher". veyonatan tirgem "veyachrezun levae", vekashe li hare hu omer "kol ram", veulay ki hahachraza tihye bekol, levad haramat kol bammaamar atzmo.

rashi: Kol kevudda vat melech penima vegomer. otam shekkol kavod taluy bahem, vehem kenesiyyot shel melech asher nahagu atzmam bitzniut, atta bigdehem chashuvim mimmishbetzot zahav shel kohanim gedolim (tanchuma, vayyishlach 6). mishbetzot katonsh belaaz:
targum: Kol shefar arag nichse pilche otzare malchaya demitamran milgav yikrevun lechahanaya dimramtzin bedahava senina levushehon:

rashi: Yeyaresh hatztzelatzal. yaasennu haarbe rash min happeri:
Yeyaresh. yaani:
Tziltzal. min arbe. vei efshar lefaresh yeyaresh leshon yerushsha, sheim ken haya lo lichtov "yirash", velo leshon horasha vegerushin, sheim ken haya lo lichtov "yorish":
Beittah achishenna. zachu – achishenna, lo zachu – beittah (sanhedrin tzach 1):
targum: Dizer behon yehe lealafa udechalash leam takif ana Adonai bezimnah aytinah:

rashi: Ki chamat adam todekka. kaasan shel reshaim gorem shehabberiyyot modim lehakkadosh baruch hu, keshehem marin kaasam vehakkabba nifra mehem hakkol mekallesin lefanav, veaf hem atzmam mekallesin lefanav kesheroin sheen kaasan kelum, kemo shemmatzinu binvuchadnetztzar keshehishlich chananya mishael vaazarya lechivshan haesh ma neemar sham "yehe shemeh deelaha mevarach vegomer" (Daniel 3:28). veal yede chen sheerit hachemot tachgor teakkev vetachdol, shear harshaim meukkavim venimnaim milleharot gaavatam vachamatam. tachgor leshon achava bilshon mishna (bechorot 37:): pegimat hassakkin kede shettachgor bo hatztzipporen. veshamati mishshemo shel rabbi elazar haggaon bar yitzchak shehaya mevi hammikra hazze edut leotah mishna. veyesh od liftor chagira zo kemashmaah leshon chagora, uferusho lecha nae lachagor chema velaatot kina ki hakkoach vehayyecholet shellecha, uleshon sheerit ze hu meachar shechamat adam eno kelum nisharu kol chagorot chema lecha:
targum: Kad ant ragez al amach ant merachem alehon vehinun yodin lishmach usheara deritcha deishtear lach min rugeza di ragezta: (401 arum kad yitkof rugezach al amach yetuvun veyodun lishmach:

rashi: Uvat tzor bemincha panayich yechallu. kemo "vaychal moshe" (Shemot 32:11), uvischar ze tizku sheyyaviu lecha ashkarim vedoron otam shehem achshav ashire am:
targum: Veyatve cherakka detzur betikruveta yeton veappayich yeshacharun levet makdeshayich attire ammaya:

rashi: Metar artzecha avak veafar. "zika devatar mitra", matar yored velo chol tzarko, veen bo kede leharebitz et heafar, veharuach baa umaala et haavak umechasse et esev hazzeraim shehem lachim min hammayim venidbak bahem, venaase tit umityabbesh umarkivin (taanit 3):

Vehayu shamecha asher al roshcha nechoshet. kelalot hallalu moshe mippi atzmo amaran, veshebbehar sinay mippi hakkabba amaran, kemashmaan, vechen neemar (Vayikra 26) "veim lo tishmeu li … veim telchu immi keri", vechan hu omer "bekol Adonai elohecha … yadbek Adonai becha … yakkecha Adonai", hekel moshe vekillotav leamran bilshon yachid. vegam ken biklala zo hekel, shebbarishonot hu omer "et shemechem kabbarzel veet artzechem kannechushsha" — shello yihyu hashshamayim mazziin kederech sheen habbarzel mazzia umittoch kach yehi chorev baolam vehaaretz tehi mazzaat kederech shehannechoshet mazzia vehi markevet peroteha, vechan hu omer "shamecha nechoshet veartzecha barzel" — sheyihyu shamayim mazziin, aappi shello yariku matar, mikkol makom lo yihye chorev shel avaddon baolam, vehaaretz lo tihye mazzia, kederech sheen habbarzel mazzia, veen happerot markivin, umikkol makom kelala hi, ben shehi kannechoshet ben shehi chabbarzel lo totzi perot, vechen hashshamayim lo yariku matar (sifra Vayikra 26):

ohc: Vehaya im shamoa vegomer. tzarich ladaat mekom gezerat hakkatuv, im hu maamar "unetancha" vegomer haya lo lomar "yittencha Adonai", ki meamro "unetancha" mashma shemmosif al hakkodem. veulay sheggezerat hakkatuv hu "tishma bekol Adonai", vehakkavvana baze ki al yede esek hattora yaale bemaalot lizkot she yedabber bo, vehu amro tishma bekol Adonai elohecha. od yimmashech lecha mehashshemia lishmor velaasot, shehattora matztzelet min hachet haramuz bashshemira, gam talmud tora gadol kocho shemmevi lide maase, vehu amro velaasot, veod lecha "unetancha Adonai elyon" vegomer.

Vechutz middarkenu yechavven hakkatuv lomar shetztzarich sheyyaasok battora begeder maalatam al haddevarim shemmimmakom kadosh elyon bau, vehu amro tishma perush, tihye shemiatcha otam kefi erech hammedabber otam shehu Adonai elohecha, veod lishmor velaasot al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 4,5) hallomed al menat lelammed maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed vehallomed al menat laasot vechulei ad kan, hare shemmuvechar hallimmud hu lekayyem, vehu amro im shamoa tishma vegomer perush, shettishma lishmor velaasot.

Unetancha Adonai elyon vegomer. hinne haadon chillek yiude hattova keneged kiyyum hammitzvot, kol echad kefi ma sherauy lo. kelalut hammitzvot hem shelosha harshumim befasuk "im shamoa tishma", vehem: talmud tora, ushemirat lo taase, vekiyyum mitzvot ase. keneged talmud tora yied beracha "unetancha Adonai elyon uvau alecha kol habberachot haelle vehissigucha", uferush hakkatuv shezze yihye keneged sechar "im shamoa" vegomer bema sheggamar omer "ki tishma bekol Adonai elohecha", hare sheyyiud ze hu keneged sechar talmud tora, vehu gam ken mechuvvan elav ki beemtzaut hattora yishtannu lemala mikkol haummot sheenam bene tora.

Veamar od uvau alecha kol habberachot vegomer, perush, nosaf al yiud "unetancha Adonai elyon" od lo berachot ellu bischar tora. veamro vehissigucha yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut reuveni parashat Vayikra) ki haadon elohe yisrael middotav rachamim, al haddofek al rachamav yemalle Adonai mishalotav leharik alav tova kaasher yachpotz, ella shebbehaggaat hattov hahu lematta yishpetu sanhedre mala im rauy, im eno rauy lo yaggio. laze amar "vehissigucha" habberachot, shezze hu ikkar hahavtacha shello yitakkevu bevatte dinim shellematta.

Vehinne timtza shekkol habberachot haamurot bainyan hem mechuvvanim keneged sechar talmud tora al ze hadderech, amro baruch atta bair vegomer al derech amram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 19:) davar ze katuv battora veshanuy banneviim umeshullash bakketuvim kol haosek betalmud tora nechasav mutzlachim.

Veamro baruch peri vitnecha, tze ulemad meoved edom haggitti asher nichnas etzlo aron hattora, ma atzmu peri vitno bizman muat, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 63:) sheishto ushemone kallotav yaldu keechad shishsha bechares echad:
Veamro baruch atta bevoecha vegomer, shettihye yetziato min haolam belo chet vechulei, (bava metzia 107.), veze yihye beemtzaut talmud tora shettagen alav mehachet:

Veamro yitten Adonai et oyvecha vegomer, al derech amro (divrei hayamim 2 20:22) "uveet hechellu verinna natan Adonai mearvim al bene ammon vehar seir vegomer vayyinnagefu", veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 127) en rinna ella tora.

Veamro yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha vegomer, gam lo sidder beracha zo lemala im hatzelachot kinyene hattovot ki sham mekomah velo achar mappelet oyev, ba lehavetiach shello yeera lo asher yeera levaal hannes asher yitkanneu bo hammekatregim al shennaasa lo davar chadash veshimmeshuhu elyonim veze hefech hatteva, vetze ulemad mimmaase rava (taanit kad:) shehorid geshamim shello beittam vechaddome laze. asher al ken amar samuch lemaamar yitten Adonai et oyvecha vegomer shezze hu nes – yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha, shello yishlot ayin hara bah. gam amar uverachcha baaretz vegomer perush shello yeasfu haummot alechem linkom nikmat hanniggafim kemo sheamar yaakov levanav bemaase shechem (Bereshit 34:30).

rashi: Yishshal. yashshir perotav, leshon venashal habbarzel (Devarim 19):
El hammakom hazze. ze bet hammikdash:
Vayyitten lanu et haaretz. kemashmao:
Az tiri venahart. "bechen techezin vetinharin" (targum yonatan):
Ufachad verachav levavech. veyitma veyirchav libbech:
Ki yehafech alayich hamon yam. "are yitchallef lich utar maarva" (targum yonatan):
Chel goyim. "nichse defalche kochvayya":
targum: Bechen techezin utenaharin vetidchelin veyifti libbich bedachalat chetin are yitchalef lich otar maarva nichse palche kochvaya yitalun legavich:

rashi: Mereshit. velo chol reshit, sheen kol happerot chayyavim bevikkurim ella shivat hamminin bilvad, neemar kan "eretz" veneemar lehallan (Devarim 8) "eretz chitta useora vegomer", ma lehallan mishivat hamminim shennishtabbecha vahen eretz yisrael, af kan shevach eretz yisrael shehen shivat minin (sifre; menachot 84):
Zayit shemen. zayit egori, sheshshamno agur betocho (sifre; berachot 39):
Udevash. hu devash temarim (sifre):
Mereshit. adam yored letoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera, chorech aleha gemi lesiman veomer "hare zo vikkurim" (sifre; bikkurim 3):
ohc: Mereshit. perush, sheim bikkeru harebe keachat eno chayyav lehavi kol reshit ella asher yachpotz mehem. uma sheamru zichronam livracha (Bikkurim 1,3) sheen lehavi ella mishshivat hamminim, nilmad haddavar bigzera shava, neemar kan "eretz" vegomer (menachot 84:). veamro kol peri, perush kol happerot sheshshibbachti lecha bahem haaretz.

Asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. perush, lefi sheshshiyyer Adonai lo chelek baaretz vehu shenat hashshemitta (Vayikra 25:4), dichtiv "uvashshana hashsheviit vegomer shabbat laAdonai", laze ba devaro hattov sheeno metzavve ella al zeman hannetina lecha shehem shesh shanim, aval shenat hashshemitta en bah havaat bikkurim lefi sheenam shello ella mufkeret lakkol.

rashi: Ki techalle laser et kol masar tevuatcha bashshana hashshelishit. keshettigmor lehaferish maasrot shel shana hashshelishit; kava zeman habbiur vehavvidduy beerev happesach shel shana harviit, shenneemar (Devarim 14) "miktze shalosh shanim totzi vegomer", neemar kan "mikketz", veneemar lehallan "mikketz sheva shanim" leinyan hakehel (Devarim 31) ma lehalan regel af kan regel, i ma lehallan chag hassukkot af kan chag hassukkot, talmud lomar ki techalle laser maasrot shel shana hashshelishit, regel shehammaasrot kalin bo vezehu pesach, sheharebe ilanot yesh shennilkatin achar hassukkot; nimtzeu maserot shel shelishit kalin befesach shel reviit, vechol mi sheshshiha maasrotav hitzricho hakkatuv levaaro min habbayit (sham 11):

Shenat hammaaser. shana sheen noheg bah ella maaser echad mishshene maasrot shennahagu vishte shanim shellefaneha, sheshshana rishona shel shemitta noheg ba maaser rishon, kemo shenneemar (Bamidbar 18) "ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser", umaaser sheni, shenneemar (Devarim 14) "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha … masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha", hare shene maasrot, uva velimmedcha chan bashshana hashshelishit sheen noheg meotan shene maasrot ella haechad, vee ze? ze maaser rishon, vetachat maaser sheni yitten masar ani, shenneemar kan venatatta lallevi et asher lo — hare maaser rishon, lagger layyatom velaalmana — ze masar ani (80 sifre):
Veachlu visharecha vesaveu. ten lahem kede savan, mikkan amru en pochatin leani baggoren pachot mechatzi kav chittim vechulei (sifre; talmud yerushalmi pea 88 10):

Heemarta … heemircha. en lahem ed mochiach bammikra, veli nire shehu leshon haferasha vehavedala — hivdalta lecha meelohe hannechar lihyot lecha lelohim vehu hifrishcha elav meamme haaretz lihyot lo leam segulla, umatzati lahem ed vehu leshon tiferet kemo (tehillim 94) "yitammeru kol poale aven":
ohc: Et Adonai heemarta hayyom lihyot vegomer. amro hayyom yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot 110:) kol haddar bechutz laaretz dome kemi sheen lo eloah, ad kan, vehu amro et Adonai heemarta hayyom davka, perush kevan shehayu baaretz hammekuddeshet, vahagam sheadayin hayu beeretz sichon veog, im kol ze kevar katavnu shehi mekuddeshet kevan shennichbesha kibbush rabbim al pi navi, uchemo shehochachnu befarashat mattot (Bamidbar 32:3), umeatta en mekomah nechshav chutza laaretz. velaze heemiru Adonai lihyot lahem lelohim, vehu amro "lihyot lecha lelohim".

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 1 108:) sheshshear haaratzot nimseru beyad sare mala, ma sheen ken eretz yisrael en aleha shofet mibbalade Adonai, vehu amro et Adonai heemarta hayyom bichnisatcha laaretz lihyot lecha lelohim, al derech amro (tehillim 17:2) "millefanecha mishpati yetze", velo yavo mishpatenu lifne sar veshofet.

Od nitkavven lomar ki yaamiru Adonai, hagam ki yeviem bammishpat latet leish kidrachav uchemaasav haraim, vehu amro et Adonai heemarta vegomer lihyot lecha lelohim, veyadua ki elohim hu middat haddin, af al pi chen yaamir Adonai vivarech al haraa meen hattova.

Velalechet bidrachav, perush, hagam shello tzivva Adonai lalechet bahem, af al pi chen kesheyyakkiru bahem shehem darche Adonai, kol asher hu ose yaasu chen bene yisrael, kegon bikkur cholim, kevurat metim vechaddome, shemmatzinu laAdonai ose otam – yelchu gam hem bidrachav. chukkav hem mitzvot sheen bahem taam, mitzvotav hem mitzvot shehassechel gam ken maskim alehem, mishpatav hem dinim shemmasar lishpot ben ish uven reehu, velishmoa bekolo ze talmud tora. vedikdek lomar "bekolo" al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba perek 14) veze leshonam: minnayin lashshomea mippi katan vechulei keshomea mippi haggevura, dichtiv (Devarim 15, Adonai) "im shamoa tishma bekol Adonai elohecha". vetaam shetztzivva al esek hattora baacharona, lehair shehagam shehissig adam ladaat kol haamur vekiyyemo, af al pi chen lo yomar: "ma li lilmod tora? im ladaat ma yaase yisrael – hinne yadati vekiyyamti kol divre Adonai!", ella af al pi chen chiyyev hakkatuv talmud tora. vehu amro achar kol ma shechiyyev laasot "velishmoa bekolo", ki mitzvat talmud tora hi mitzva bifne atzmah sheen zeman lippater mimmenna ad yom moto, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19, 14) "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel".

rashi: Vehinnachto. maggid shennotlo achar hanafat hakkohen veochazo veyado keshehu kore vechozer umenif (sifre; socha 47):
Bashshachefet. shebbesaro nishchaf venafuach:
Uvakkaddachat. leshon "ki esh kadcha veappi" (Devarim 32), vehu esh shel cholim, malevavey belaaz, shehi chamma meod:
Uvaddalleket. chamma yoter mikkaddachat, umine cholaim hem:
Uvacharchur. choli hamechammo toch hagguf vetzame tamid lammayim, uvelaaz ayshateradeymenat, leshon "veatzmi chara minni chorev" (Iyov 30) "nachar mappuach meesh" (Yirmeyahu 6):
Uvacherev. yavi alech geyasot:
Uvashshiddafon uvayyerakon. makkat tevua shebbassadot:
Shiddafon. ruach kadim, ashelaydah belaaz:
Yerakon. yovesh, ufene hattevua machsifin venehpachin leyerakon, 141 (nusach acher — 307) belaaz:
Ad ovdecha. targum "ad detevad", kelomar ad avod otcha — shettichle meelecha:
Avon avotav. avon sheheeva al avotav, leavraham sheggara chamesh shanim mechayyav (Bereshit Rabba 63,12), uleaviv garam kihyon enayim (Bereshit Rabba 65,4-5):

Vechattat immo. shehishchit rachmah vesheggaram lehaalim yom kevuratah min habberiyyot, shello yekalluha sheyyatza mikkeresah esav, kemo shenneemar (Bereshit 35:8) "vattamat devora meneket rivka vegomer allon bachut", bilshon yevani korin leacher allon, sheevel acher haya leyaakov im shel devora, shemmeta immo veheelimu mitatah:
targum: Yidkar ivyat avahatoy kodam Adonai vechovat imeh la titmeche:

rashi: Al tzad teamana. "al gissin" (targum yonatan), kesalim shel melachim tihyena amunot:
targum: Zekufi yerushelem sechor sechor enach vechaze kol bene am galvatach demitkanshin veatan legavich benach merachik yetun uvenatach al gissin yitnasvan:

rashi: Yaan asher lo zachar asot chased. laasok beevel aviv, kemo sheasa yaakov nezid adashim lenachem et yitzchak (Bereshit 25:29), shebbeoto hayyom met avraham (bava batra 16:):
Ish ani. yisrael:
targum: Mitul dela idkar lemebad tevu veradef gevar anya vachashicha umakkich libba leitkatala:

rashi: Vahakemota lach. bayyarden, veachakka totzi mishsham acherot vetivne mehen mizbeach behar eval; nimtzet atta omer shelosha mine avanim hayu — shetem esre bayyarden uchenegdan baggilgal uchenegdan behar eval, kidita vemassechet sota (daf 35):

ohc: Vehaya im lo tishma vegomer. hitna hakkatuv al shelosha devarim: talmud tora, ushemirat mitzvot lo taase, vekiyyum mitzvot ase, shetztzarich sheyyihyu shelashtam yachad. hakkavvana shehagam shellamad tora im lo yishmor, o im yishmor velo yaase, o im yaase shenehem veyibbatel mittalmud tora, yavou alav hakkelalot rachamana litzlan kaasher yevaer ma shennogea lechol achat mehenna onesh kol echad bifne atzmo. vehitchil beonesh bittul talmud tora veamar arur atta bair vegomer ad maamar "vead avadcha maher", vegamar omer mippene roa maalalecha asher azavtani. hare shehakkelalot hachamurot ad atta hem keneged azivat hattora ki haozev tora keozev Adonai, vechen timtza shehikpid Adonai kol kach al azivat hattora veamar (yirmeya 9:11) "al ma avda haaretz vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati", vehu amro kan vead avadcha maher mippene roa maalalecha asher azavtani.

rashi: Ad redet chomotecha. leshon ridduy vechibbush:
Berosh tidhar uteashshur. mine atze yaar levanon:
targum: Yekar livnan legavich yital birvan morneyan veeshkarin kachada leshabbecha atar bet makdeshi vaatar bet ashrayut shechinti ayaker:

rashi: Kaasher yide hannasher. pitom vedarko matzlachat veyekallu susav:
Lo tishma leshono. lo takkir leshono, vechen "tishma chalom liftor oto" (Bereshit 41), vechen "ki shomea yosef" (sham 42), aynateynedarey:
Uveshilyatah. baneha hakketannim — bechullan tehe enah tzara keshettochal et haechad millitten laasher etzlah min habbasar:

Vattavou el hammakom hazze. atta attem roim atzmechem bigdulla vechavod, al tevaatu vammakom veal yarum levavchem ushemartem et divrei habberit hazzot; davar acher — velo natan Adonai lachem lev ladaat sheen adam omed al sof dato shel rabbo vechachmat mishnato ad arbaim shana, ulefichach lo hikpid alechem hammakom ad hayyom hazze, aval mikkan vaelach yakpid, ulefichach ushemartem et divrei habberit hazzot vegomer (avoda zara Adonai):
Tachat hannechoshet. shennatlu mimmech:
Vesamti fekuddatech shalom. "vaashavvi parnasach shelam veshaltonich bizchu" (targum yonatan):
Fekuddatech. pekidim shellach, verabbotenu amru (bava batra 9 1): happekuddot shebbau alecha begalutech vehannogsim sheddechakuch yihyu lach lshalom velitzedaka:
targum: Chalaf nechasha divzo minich yerushelem ayte dahava vachalaf barzela ayte chaspa vachalaf aaya nechasha vachalaf avnaya barzela vaashave parnasach shelam veshiltunayich bezachu:
Veyivnon charvat alam tzadyat kadmae yekommun vichadtun kirvin dahavaa charban tzadya dar vedar:
Shabbachu kodam Adonai barichu shemeh basarun mioma leyoma purekaneh:
Chalaf dahavet shevika umetaltela velet deade vaashavinach likar alam vet ditz dar vedar:
Kumi anhari yerushelem are meta zeman purekanich vikara dayya alach yitgeli:
La yishtema od chitfa bearich biza utevira bitchumich viarun purekan al shurach veal tarach yehon meshabbechin:
Yittetyan bechedvan vetushebcheta veyaalun vehechla demelech almin:
Vihachon ammin linhorich umalchaya likvel zehorich:
Are am umalchu dela yiflechunich yerushelem yevdun veammaya ishtetzaa yishtetzun:
Man ilen deatan bigle kaananin kalilin vela itakkava galvata deyisrael demitkanshin veatyan learahon ha cheyonin detayvan lego shovchehon:
Are ha chashocha yachpe ara vekivla lemalkevata uvich yishre shechinta dayya vikare alach yitgele:

bart: Parim hannisrafin. par kohen mashiach, ufar helem davar shel tzibbur, ufar shel yom hakkippurim:
Useirim hannisrafim. seir yom hakkippurim useire avoda zara:
Nisrafin bevet haddeshen. chutz leshalosh machanot. uvevet olamim, chutz lirushalayim. dichtiv behu el michutz lammachane, kelomar chutz leshalosh machanot:

Metammein begadim. laasukim bahem. kedichtiv (Vayikra yv) vehassoref otam yechabbes begadav. vechol makom shenneemar yechabbes begadav, lo bilvad habbegadim shehu lavush teunin kibbus, ella kol beged shehu nogea bo beodo mechubbar lattame, nitma vetaun kibbus:
Shello chemitzvatan. kegon shennifselu uteunin serefa kishar pesule hammukdashim:

Bevet habbira. peamim baazara ufeamim behar habbayit. ketzad, era bahen pesul kodem yetziatan min haazara, ben kodem zerika ben leachar zerika, nisrafin bevet haddeshen haggadol shebbaazara. era bahen pesul achar yetziatan min haazara, nisrafin bevet haddeshen shebbehar habbayit, vehu bet hammikdash:
Ben gedolim. mashkin hayyotzin mippi tabbaat:
Ben ketannim. me raglayim:
Vedam hakkaza lishtiyya. dam hahakkaza shennitkavven alav lehashekoto livhema ulechayya o lenachri:
Me hechalav. hu hakkerum hannifrash min haggevina keshemmaamidim hechalav umakpiin oto bakkeva, machshir et hazzeraim:
Vehammochal kashshemen. mayim shechorim hayyotzim min hazzetim:
Sheen mochal yotze mide shemen. umochal atzmo, lerabbi shimon me ferot hu veeno chashuv mashke, aval machshir mippene sheyure shemen shebbo:
Rabbi meir omer af al pi sheen bo shamen. mochal atzmo chashuv mashke umachshir umetamme. vahalacha kerabbi meir:

Dam hashsheretz kivsaro. umitztarfin lechaadasha. dichtiv bishmona sheratzim (Vayikra 11) veze lachem hattame, lehavi damo shemmetamme chivsaro. yachol yachshir et hazzeraim, talmud lomar hattame, tame hu veeno machshir et hazzeraim:
Kasya shel shulchanot. kissuy shemmechassin al hashshulchan shello yippol al hammazon shealav mayim o davar shel tinnuf velichluch:
Vehashshifa shel levenim. machtzelet shel shifa veshel gemi shemmechassim al hallevenim lehagen min haggeshamim. vahare ellu kemo vishvil shello yilke hakkotel sheenan bechi yuttan:
Aval im nier. shemmitkavven lahadicham, hare ze bechi yuttan:
Velo yikra lammeturgeman yoter mippasuk echad. shello yite hammeturgeman, shemmetargem al pe:
Uvannavi shelosha. im yirtze. velo ichpat lan im yite, delo nafka lan horaa minnayhu:

Veim shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot. kegon ki cho amar Adonai‏ chinnam nimkartem, ki ko amar Adonai‏ mitzrayim yarad ammi barishona, veatta ma li fo neum Adonai, hem shalosh parashiyyot bishlosha mikraot retzufim:
Medallegin bannavi. mipparasha lefarasha, vaafillu meinyan leinyan:
Veen medallegin battora. bishne inyanim. aval beinyan echad medallegin, kemo shehaya kohen gadol kore beyom hakkippurim parashat achare mot, umedalleg vekore ach beasor:

Ad shello yafsik hatturgeman. hamedalleg ben battora beinyan echad, ben bannavi vaafillu bishne inyanim, lo yishhe ella bichde sheyyashlim hammeturgeman letargem ma shehu tzarich letargem, sheen kavod latztzibbur laamod sham bishtika:
Ulevidduy happarim. par kohen mashiach, ufar helem davar shel tzibbur, shemmitvaddim alehem chetam shehevium alav:
Ulevidduy maaser. biarti hakkodesh min habbayit:
Lassemicha. vesamach et yado al rosh haola:
Lahaggasha. maggish et hammincha techilla bekeren maaravit deromit shel mizbeach, veachar kach kometz:
Velakkemitza velahaktara. behaketarat kometz kaamar, shehu bemincha keneged zerikat dam bazzevachim, veenah keshera ella bayyom. aval hekter chalavim veevarim kasher kol hallayla keditnan bematnitin:
Lakkabbala. kabbalat haddam bemazrek:
Lahazzaya. hazzayat parim hannisrafim vechol chattaot happenimiyyot. uzerikat dam al hammizbeach nammi kare hazzaya:
Mashkin bet hashshelachin. eretz ayefa utzemea lemayim. targum ayef veyagea, meshalhe velae:

Mashkin bammoed. dedavar haaved muttar bammoed, usede bet hashshelachin mishshaa shemmatchil lehashekoto im eno mashke oto tadir miyyad neevad, keditnan besof matnitin, zeraim shello shatu lifne hammoed lo yashkem bammoed delo pasde, aval shatu lifne hammoed yashkem bammoed. vedavka sede lavan shel tevua shehu shelachin mashkin bammoed, aval sede shelachin shel ilan lo share bammoed, delo pasde. uvashsheviit share lehashekot ben sede bet hashshelachin ben sede bet habbaal. uvet hashshelachin, mishshum moed bilvad nakat la:
Sheyyatza vattechilla. sheyyotze achshav mittechilla. veen choshshin hoil vechadash hu shemma yippelu gedotav veate letakken bammoed veikka tircha:
Shello yatza vattechilla. shehu yashan:
Aval lo mimme geshamim. gezera mishshum me kilon. kilon hem mayim shel bor amok uvo me geshamim mechunnasim, deveh ikka tircha yetera lidlot:
Ugiyyot. charitzim sheosim beikkere hazzetim uveikkere haggefanim kede sheyyitmalleu mayim:
Katan kore battora. veyesh min haggeonim sheamru davka mishshelishi vaelach:
Aval eno pores al shema. lefi shehu ba lehotzi et harabbim yede chovatan, vechol sheeno chayyav baddavar eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan:
Veeno nose et kappav. im hu kohen, sheen kavod latztzibbur sheyyihyu kefufin levirchato:
Pocheach. begadav keruim uzerootav nirim mibbachutz. arom veyachef, metargeminan pocheach veyachef:
Pores al shema. shehare hu mechuyyav baddavar:
Aval eno kore vattora. mippene kevod hattora. vechen lifne hatteva vechen linsiat kappayim, mippene sheggenay hu latztzibbur:
Suma pores al shema. sheaf al pi sheeno roe meorot yesh lo hanaa min hammeorot, shebbene adam roin oto umatztzilin oto min hammichsholim:
Rabbi yehuda omer kol mi shello raa meorot miyyamav lo yifros. shello haya lo hanaa mehem leolam. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Beged. shennittaz alav dam chattat veyatza chutz lakkelaim:
Nitma chutz lakkelaim. leachar sheyyatza. vei efshar lehachenis tuma laazara:
Koro. berubbo. vetahor mittuma:

Venichnas umechabbeso vemakom kadosh. veaf al gav deveged shennitma ukerao verubbo adayin hu betumato midderabbanan ad shello yishshaer bechibburo kede rochav sudar, hacha share lehacheniso laazara kede lekayyem bo mitzvat kibbus, kevan demiddeorayta keshennikra rubbo tahor:

Nokvo. letaharo mittumato vedavka nekev keshiur shoresh katan, devaze tahar mittumato vaadayin keli hu umekayyem bo mitzvat shevira bammikdash, aval im nikkav nekev gadol, deyatza mittorat keli, shuv eno nichnas veshovro, derachamana amar ucheli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver, bishat shevira yihye keli, vehay bishat shevira lo have keli:

Ufashat av hattuma et yadav letochah temea. dichli cheres mekabbel tuma meav hattuma hannogea betocho, velo alta lo tevila, veaf al pi shehu vetoch hammikve, lefi shehammayim shebbetocho chotztzim beno uven me hammikve:

Magga tumot tehora. im lo haya av hattuma shennaga bah, ella rishon lattuma vehu hannikra magga tumot, kelomar hannogea baavot hattuma, az tehora hakkedera, lefi sheen keli cheres mekabbel tuma ella meav hattuma, venimtza shello nitmet hakkedera ella mechamat mashkim temeim shebbetochah shennitmeu vechozrim umetammeim otah, umishshum hachi enah metammea, shehare hushsheku hammayim shebbetochah beme mikve venitharu. aval shear mashkim kegon yayin shemen vechalav, en hammikve metaher otam, delo salka lehu hashshaka, hilkach chozrim umetammeim et hakkedera, derabbanan gazru al hammashkim sheyyihyu metammein kelim, gezera mishshum mashke zav vezava:

Bayyom hashshelishi lisfirat zovo. kegon baal shete reiyyot shetztzarich lispor shiva nekiyyim, umana rishon vesheni, uvashshelishi raa keri, satar shene yamim shellefanav, vechozer umone shiva kevattechilla:
Lo satar ella yomo. umone chamishsha lehashelim shiva, dishnayim harishonim alu lo:
Haroe vashsheni. shemmana echad, uvashsheni raa keri, satar et shellefanav afillu levet hillel. verabbi akiva savar divha nammi felige. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:

Umodim bet shammay beroe keri varvii shello satar ella yomo. veshellefanav alu lo. dedavka cheshello nifsak hazzivut bishlosha yamim tehorim kemispar hayyamim sheose zav gamur, hu deamre vet shammay deshichvat zera soteret, aval leachar sheavru shelosha yamim tehorim, modim bet shammay sheen keri soter ella yomo. vehay dekeri soter bezav, nafka lan mikkera dichtiv (Vayikra 15) zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zera, ma zov soter, af shichvat zera soter. i ma zov soter et hakkol af shichvat zera tistor et hakkol, talmud lomar letama vah, en lah ella yom echad. aval im raa zov, afillu yom shevii, soter et shellefanav, dichtiv shivat yamim letohorato, ad sheyyihyu chol shivat hayyamim tehorim min hazzivut:
Chutz mishshel mochre mashke. mippene shennogim bahem beod shemmashke tofeach al yedehem, veen makpidin al hallichluch, shekkelippatam meginna alehen:
Veim hayu mochrim immahem perot yeveshim. mittoch shemmenaggevim yedehem kede shello yetannefu et happerot, menaggevim yedehem nammi kodem sheyyiggeu vabbetzim:
Kol haddagim bechezkat tuma. lefi shehem muchsharim bammayim, vehattame vehattahor memashmeshim bah:
Chatichat hailtot. min dag shergilin lemachro chatichot chatichot. umakom yesh sheshshemo iltot vesham tzadin oto umochrin oto:
Vedag hammitzri. dag katan meod shemmeviin mimmennu kuppot meleot bemitzrayim:

Vekuleyas haispanin. min dag sheoro rach meod vekorin lo 352. ushelosha minim hallalu en hammayim machshirin otam kishar dagim, lefi shehen chayyin zeman merubbe achar tzedatan, uleachar shehen naasin ochel dehaynu leachar mitatan en notnin alehem mayim, lefi shehammayim mafsidin otan. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hatztzir bechezkat tuma. shessetam tzir natnu vo mayim, vehayyadayim memashmeshim bo:
Veal kullam. ben betzim ben perot ben tzir:
Neeman. am haaretz lomar lo huchsheru:
Mippene shemmafkidim otan. dechol happerot mafkidim otan etzel am haaretz, vei lav deneeman heach mafkidim. aval daga en mafkidim beyado, lefichach eno neeman:
Tzir tahor. sheyyadua bo shello huchshar al yede mashke:
Shennafal letocho mayim kol shehu tame. demayim kol shehu machshirim oto, umishshehuchshar chezkato tame, shehayyadayim memashmeshim bo. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:
Hayu sovlin otan. et hannisrafim kemitzvatan hayu nosin otan bemotot lehotzian levet serefatan:
Harishonim. bene adam hannosim bammot. otan shebbaroosh haechad yotzim rishonim, vehaacharonim shebbarosh hashsheni lo yatzu:

Nittach habbasar. nigmera serefatan, en hamesayyea shuv bahen metamme vegadim. aval mikkamme hachi kol hamesayyein bishat serefa metammeim begadim, dichtiv vehassoref otam yechabbes begadav, bishat serefa. yachol hamesayyea leachar shennaasu efer metamme vegadim, talmud lomar otam, otam metamme vegadim, naasu efer eno metamme vegadim. ufarim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim atzman en metammein adam uvegadim shennogim bahem, ella hammitassek bisrefatan tame miggezerat hakkatuv. ledivre rabbanan mishsheyyetzu hassovlim bammotot, uledivre rabbi shimon mishsheyyutztzat haur berubban. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ben ir. shezzemanno bearbaa asar:
Shehalach lichrach. shezzemanno bachamishsha asar:

Im atid lachazor limkomo. im hu ben kerach shehalach leir veatid latzet min hair belel arbaa asar kodem ammud hashshachar, af al pi shehu ballayla bair, hoil uvayyom lo yihye bair en ze afillu paruz leyomo, hilkach kore kimkomo bachamishsha asar. aval im eno atid latzet mishsham hallayla, dehashta have peruz leoto hayyom, af al pi sheatid lachzor lemachar o leyom acher, nikra paruz vekore immahem. vehu haddin leven ir shehalach lichrach, im atid lachzor belel chamishsha asar lo have mukkaf leyomo, vekore beyom arbaa asar, veaf al pi shehu bakkerach. aval im en atid lachzor belel chamishsha asar, eno kore bearbaa asar ella mamtin vekore immahen. vehachi mefarshe la lematnitin baggemara:
Rabbi meir omer kullah. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Hakkore et hammegilla omed veyoshev. ratza omed ratza yoshev:
Kerauha shenayim. beyachad:
Yatzu. velo amrinan shene kolot en nishmain keechad, dechevan dachaviva lehu yahave datayhu:

Mekom shennahagu levarech. achareha, yevarech. aval lefaneha chayyav levarech bechol makom shalosh berachot, al mikra megilla, vesheasa nissim, veshehecheyanu. ben ballayla ben bayyom. dikria shel yom ikkar, dichtiv (Ester 9) vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim. veikka leman deamar dechevan shebberech shehecheyanu ballayla lo yevarech bayyom shehecheyanu. vehachi mistabbera:
Veen mosifin alehen. shello yikshe latztzibbur, mippene shehen yeme melacha. veshabbat bammincha nammi samuch lachashecha hu, shehare kol hayyom hayu regilim lidrosh. umehay tama nammi en maftirin:

Happoteach vehachotem battora mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. hammatchil likrot battora rishon, mevarech lefaneha. vehaacharon, hachotem shehu hammashlim, mevarech leachareha. vechol shear hakkorin battora en mevarchin lo lefaneha velo leachareha. vehaidna nehige alma dechullehu mevarchin lefaneha uleachareha, gezera mishshum hannichnasim velo shamu harishon shebberech lefaneha veyomru en beracha battora lefaneha, umishshum hayyotzim velo yishmeu hachotem mevarech leachareha veharishonim lo berchu, veyomru en beracha battora leachareha:
Hammaale ferotav laggag mippene hakkenima. tolaim haggedelim bapperot. leshon vattehi hakkinnam (Shemot 8):
Im nitkavven lechach. shechashav sheyyered alehen tal:
Sheyyesh lahen maase. kegon im hayu shofchin alehen tal bechavvana, hayu muchsharin:

Befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim. shor o chesev o ez. uveyoma kamma mayre. vehaidna nahug alma shekkorin beyom rishon mishchu ukechu lachem, umaftirin befesach gilgal. bashsheni shor o chesev, umaftirin befesach yoshiyyahu. bashshelishi kaddesh li kol bechor. barvii im kesef talve. bachamishi pesal lecha. bashshishshi vayyaasu bene yisrael et happesach bemoado. bashshevii shirat hayyam, umaftirin vaydabber david. bashshemini shehu yom tov acharon shel galuyyot korin kol habbechor, umaftirin od hayyom benov laamod. baatzeret, beyom tov rishon, bachodesh hashshelishi, umaftirin bammerkava shel yechezkel. beyom tov sheni shel galuyyot korin kol habbechor, umaftirin bachavakkuk. berosh hashshana vaAdonai‏ pakad et sara, divrosh hashshana nifkeda sara, umaftirin bechanna sheggam hi nifkeda berosh hashshana. beyom tov sheni baakeda, umaftirin haven yakkir li efrayim. beyom hakkippurim shacharit korin beachare mot, umaftirin ko amar ram venissa. bemincha korin baarayot, umaftirin beyona. bishne yamim tovim shel chag korin shor o chesev o ez, umaftirin beyom tov rishon hinne yom ba laAdonai‏, uveyom tov sheni vayyikkahalu el hammelech. ushear kol yemot hechag korin bekarbenot hechag. ketzad, yom shelishi shehu yom rishon shel chol hammoed, kohen kore uvayyom hashsheni, levi kore uvayyom hashshelishi, yisrael kore uvayyom harvii, veharvii chozer vekore uvayyom hashsheni uvayyom hashshelishi. uvayyom harvii kohen kore uvayyom hashshelishi, levi kore uvayyom harvii, yisrael kore uvayyom hachamishi, veharvii chozer vekore uvayyom hashshelishi uvayyom harvii. vechen kullam. beyom tov acharon shel chag, kol habbechor, umaftirin vayhi kechallot shelomo. ulemachar korin vezot habberacha, umaftirin vayhi achare mot moshe. veshabbat shechal lihyot bechullo shel moed, ben befesach ben besukkot, korin ree atta omer elay, umaftirin, befesach, haatzamot hayeveshot, uvesukkot, beyom bo gog. shemmasoret beyadenu ditchiyyat hammetim atida lihyot befesach, umilchamot gog umagog besukkot:
Yevarchucha tovim hare zo derech minut. shetztzerichin yisrael letzaref immahem poshe yisrael baaguddat taaniyyotehem, shehare chelbena rechah ra umennaa hakkatuv im sammane hakketoret:

Al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha. kemo shehiggiu rachamecha al kan tzippor vegazarta lo tikkach haem al habbanim (Devarim 22), ken chus verachem alenu. mashtikin oto, sheose mitzvotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu rachamim, vehem enan ella gezerot:
Veal tov yizzacher shemecha. al tovatcha node lecha. mashtikin oto, sheanu chayyavim levarech al haraa keshem shemmevarchin al hattova:
Modim modim. demechaze kishte reshuyyot, kemode umekabbel alav shene elohut:
Hammechanne vaarayot. sheddoresh parasha shel arayot bilshon kinnuy, sheomer delo baarayot mammash dibber hakkatuv ella shello yegalle kelon aviv ukelon immo barabbim:
Umizzarach lo titten leabara bearmayuta. lo tavo al haggoya vetolid ben laavoda zara:
Meshattekin oto vinzifa. sheoker hakkatuv mimmashmauto, venoten karet labba al haggoya, umechayyevo chattat al hashshogeg:
Tevul yom. shettaval veala velo heeriv shimsho:
Umechussar kippurim. kegon zav umetzora veyoledet shettavlu veheeriv shimshan velo heviu kapparatan:

Enan cholkim bakkodashim. hoil veen reuyin laachila en cholkim leechol laerev kesheyyittaharu, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) hakkohen hamechatte otah yochalenna, kohen harauy lechittuy cholek, sheeno rauy lechittuy eno cholek. vei efshar lomar kohen sheeno rauy lechittuy bishat hakerava eno ochel, deha ikka katan deeno rauy lechittuy veochel, ella al karchacha yochalenna deamar kera yachlok bah kede leechol mimmenah kaamar, umiddeappekah kera lachaluka vilshon achila, shema minna dechohen harauy laachila cholek, sheen rauy laachila eno cholek. hilkach baale mumin cholkin, sheaf al pi sheen reuyin lechittuy, reuyin hen laachila, kedichtiv (sham 21) umin hakkodashim yochal:
Onen nogea. vehu shettaval velo hissiach dato min hattevila kol zeman shehu onen. sheim hissiach dato venaga, afillu leachar shettaval pasal:

Vechol sheeno rauy laavoda eno cholek babbasar. chutz mibbaale mumin sheaf al pi sheenan reuyin laavoda cholkim babbasar, derabbinhu kera behedya, dichtiv (sham) lechem elohav mikkadshe hakkodashim vegomer, uchetiv (sham 6) kol zachar bivne aharon yochalenna, lerabbot baale mumin lemachaloket, i laachila hare chevar amur umin hakkodashim yochal:
Vetahor bishat hekter chalavim. shehu kol hallayla. kegon shettaval vetahar behaarev shemesh:
Eno cholek. sheen hakkohen cholek bakkodashim ad sheyyehe tahor mishsheat zerikat damim ad sheat hekter chalavim, veim nitma ben kach uven kach eno cholek:

Hamemalle vekilon. keshehammayim mechunnasim bemakom echad umevakkeshim lahavian el sade acher, osim lahen derech sheyyavou vo otan hammayim, veshem oto derech sheotan hammayim nimshachim bo nikra kilon, vead shelosha yamim en oto kilon mitnaggev min hammayim shehimshichu letocho, umachshirin et happerot shennaflu letochan, shehare hen leratzon:

Rabbi akiva omer im niggevu miyyad. rabbi akiva lo faleg attanna kamma. distam kilon eno mitnaggev ad shelosha yamim, vetanna kamma bistam ayre. vehachi muchach behedya battosefta, demode rabbi akiva bistam shehu shelosha yamim:
Ella al tenay. vaafillu mishshel rabbim larabbim asur limkor mechira chaluta, dederech bizzayon hu, kelomar eno beenenu kelum. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Mimkar olam. vaafillu leyachid, vaafillu lechol tashmishin chutz mearbaa devarim, dilotam arbaa devarim lo yimkor:
Bet hammayim. lichvisa. i nammi leme raglayim:
Rabbi yehuda omer mochrin oto leshem chatzer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Serugin. shekkara meat veshaha, vechazar vekara meat veshaha, afillu shaha yoter mikkede ligmor et kullah, yatza:
Haya chotvah kulei. kegon dichtiva kullah umannecha kammeh vekari pesuka pesuka bimgilleta demancha kammeh vechatav lah, delo nafek yede chovateh ella keshekkore bimgilla shehi ketuva kullah:
Im kivven libbo. latzet bikria zo:
Besam. shoresh esev shekkorin lo samma:
Besikra. even shetztzovim bah adom:
Komos. min seraf, uvelaaz gome:
Kankantom. 263 belaaz, uvearvi 11:
Neyar. asuy measavim al yede devek vechotvim alav:
Diftera. or shello nishlam tikkuno, dimliach ukemiach velo afitz:
Al hassefer. al hakkelaf:
Hashshochet. kadashim bachutz veheelan bachutz behelem echad, chayyav al hashshechita vechayyav al hahaalaa, shehen shene gufe avera, detarvayhu chetive asher yishchat vaasher yaale:

Kevan shehotzio pesalo. vaafillu hachi chayyav, vehu haddin leshochet bachutz umaale bachutz. verabbi yose haggelili amar lecha, ma leshochet bifnim umaale bachutz shekken hayta lo sheat hakkosher, tomar leshochet bachutz umaale bachutz shello hayta lo sheat hakkosher. veen halacha kerabbi yose haggelili:

Bene hair. rechovah shel ir. yesh bah kedushsha, shemmitpallelin bah battaaniyyot. vachachamim pelige al setam matnitin veamre rechovah shel ir en bah mishshum kedushsha, hoil veen mitpallelin bah ella beakray bealma. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bet hakkeneset lokchim teva. vedavka bet hakkeneset dichfarim hu dematzu mezabbene la, aval bet hakkeneset dichrakkim kevan demealma ka atu la, haveya derabbim velo matzu mezabbene la:
Sefarim. neviim uchetuvim:
Aval im machru tora lo yikchu sefarim. demaalin bakkodesh veen moridin:
