Vechen bemotrehen. machru sefarim velakchu mimmiktzat haddamim tora, lo yikkechu min hammotar davar shekkedushshato pechuta. velo neemru kol haddevarim hallalu ella keshello machru shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair, aval im machru shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair, afillu liknot baddamim shechar lishtot muttar. vedavka beshel kefarim kidamrinan:

Hammakriv kadashim veemurehen. shehikriv habbasar vehaemurim mechubbarim bo, chayyav mishshum emurim. velo amrinan hare vasar chotzetz ben haemurin laesh vedichvata bifnim lav haalaa hi derachamana amar (sham 1) al haetzim asher al haesh, vehammaalan bachutz nammi lo yehe chayyav. lo amrinan hachi, lefi shemmin bemino eno chotzetz:
Mincha shello nikmetza. enah reuya lifnim. hilkach hammakrivah bachutz patur:
Kematzah vechazar kumtzah letochah vehikrivah bachutz chayyav. shekkayyotze vah bifnim keshera, keditnan behakkometz (menachot 83 41) nitarev kumtzah bishyareha lo yaktir veim hiktir keshera:

Shehaya fesulan bakkodesh. kegon hallan vehayyotze vehannishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, hoil uvifnim im alu lo yerdu, mitkabbel bifnim karinan beh vechayyavin alehen bachutz, dichtiv (sham) laasot oto laAdonai, kol hannaase laAdonai‏ chayyavin alav bachutz, vechol sheeno naase laAdonai‏ en chayyavin alav bachutz:
Hammaale chazzayit min haola umeemurin. chatzi zayit mizze vachatzi zayit mizze:
Chayyav. dechullah kalil:
Hallevona. shel minchat nedava:
Vehakketoret. shel kol yom peras shacharit uferas ben haarbayim:
Uminchat kohanim. shehi chalil ureuya lehaalaa kakkometz shel minchat yisrael. aval sheyare minchat yisrael eno chayyav al haalaatan bachutz:
Minchat kohen mashiach. asirit haefa shehu mevi bechol yom:
Kazzayit. dehaynu shiur haketara:

Ad sheyyakriv et kullan. dekasavar kol hammattirin mippasle bechissaron, vechol zeman shello karvu chullan lo haveya haketara latzet bealim yede chovatan. ulerabbanan hane nammi have haketaratan bechazzayit, hecha dechullo kayyam velo chasru kodem haketara:
Veshiyyer mehen vechulei‏ chayyav. shehare vaze nigmera haketara:
Vechullan shechasru chol shehen. kodem haketara al yede ibbud o serefa, nifselu bechesronan, dichtiv (Vayikra 2) vehannoteret min hammincha, perat leshechasra hi o shechaser kumtzah kodem haketara:
Haamma. charitzim sheosim bakkarka shebbahen hammayim holchim seviv hassade umissade lesade, keruyin amma, lefi shehen rochav amma berum amma:
Battechilla. im lo hayta meolam en osin otah battechilla bammoed, mishshum tircha:
Uvashsheviit. mippene shennire kechofer bakkarka bashsheviit:
Umetakkenim et hammekulkelet. im nafal letochah afar veenah mekallachat, metakkenim otah, aval en osim otah battechilla bammoed. vahalacha kachachamim:
Umetakkenim kilkule hammayim. mayim hammechunnasim baggummot lishtot mehen:
Vechottin. menakkin umenakkerin umotziin mittochan tzerorot vekismin veafrurit shennafal bahen:
Umetzayyenin. osin tziyyunin al hakkevarot. shehayu memachin sid veshofchin al hakkever, vehu siman leholche derachim shello yaavru bimkom tuma:
Veyotzin. sheluche bet din bammoed leayyen hassadot shennizreu kilayim, laakor otam. lefi shennotlin sachar al kach mitterumat hallishka, uvime hammoed niskarim bezol, mippene shehen betelim:
Af bilvanim lo yaavor. chayshinan shemma minut nizreka bo, deovde avoda zara makpidin bechach:
Haose tefillin shebberosho agullot. keegoz o kevetza:
Sakkana. shello tikkanes berosho:
Veen bah mitzva. ditfillin merubbaot halacha lemoshe missinay:

Hare ze derech minut. shebbozim divre chachamim veholchim achar mashmaut hammikra, veomrim ben enecha mammash, al yadcha mammash. vachachamim lamdu bigzera shava ben enecha, bimkom sear shebbarosh, mekom shemmocho shel tinok rofes. al yadcha, begova hayyad, kibboret berosh hazzeroa, shettehe keneged hallev:
Tzippan zahav vechulei. vehakkatuv omer (Shemot 13) lemaan tihye torat Adonai‏ beficha, min hammuttar beficha, sheyyehe hakkol meor behema tehora velo mizzahav:
Unetanah al bet unkeli. al bet yad hammalbush mibbachutz. vehakkatuv omer lecha leot, velo laacherim leot:
Hare ze derech hachitzonim. bene adam haholchim achar datam chutz middaat hachachamim:
Parat chattat. para adumma. shenneemar bah chattat hi:

Chutz miggittah. maaracha shel etzim mesuddarin kemin gat hayu osim lah bemakom sheshshochatim otah behar hammishcha keneged pitcho shel hechol. veim shachatah chutz lammakom hahu pesula. aval eno chayyav aleha mishshum shochet kadashim bachutz, derachamana patreh middichtiv veel petach ohel moed lo hevio, umiddekafed kera leansho shello hevio, shema minna beomed lahavio sham mishtae kera:
Kol sheeno rauy lavo kulei. sheeno atid lehakeriv:

Natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim chayyav. milleta difshita hi, umishshum sefa nakat la, natan bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz, sheeno noten bachutz ella sheyare haddam, chayyav. umatnitin kerabbi nechemya desavar shirayim meakkevim. veenah halacha:
Shenehen bachutz chayyav. achat. veim hayta lo yedia bentayim, chayyav shetayim:
Echad bifnim. veachar kach hashsheni vachutz, patur. vaafillu lerabbi nechemya desavar kos echad ose et chavero dachuy lihyot nishpach laamma, hilkach afillu shirayim lo have:
Vehappenimi mechapper. lehacheshir hazzevach. shehaddam hannizrak techilla bachutz lo asa hameshuyyar kayyotze vo:
Shetehen bachutz chayyav. al kol achat veachat. devishat shechita kol achat hayta reuya bifnim:
Achat bifnim. vehashsheniyya achar ken bachutz, patur. dehavya la chattat shennitkapperu vealeha, ulemita azla veenah mitkabbelet bifnim:
Chayyav al hachitzona. deha chazya lifnim, deeze mehen sheyyirtze yakrivah:
Keshem sheddamah poter et besarah. min hammeila, [dizrikat dam motzia vesar kodesh kadashim min hammeila, deyahava vah] sheat hetter lakkohanim:

Kach hu foter et besar chavertah. veaf al pi sheppesula [veashshachat shenehem bifnim kae]. veashmeinan hacha dehecha demunnachot shetehen vekadam vezarak et dam haachat, patar et chavertah min hammeila mishshum chattat shennitkapperu vealeha, dekayma lan hachattaot hammetot lo nehenin velo moalin:

Malak bachutz. nevela hi, sheen melika ella bifnim, lechach patur al haalaato vachutz. veim tomar vahalo kol hannaalim bachutz nifselu bitziatan, vechen hashshochet bachutz pasul hu vechayyavin al haalaato, hatam rachamana rabbeye, aval leinyan shear pesulim mitkabbelim bifnim bainan:
Shachat bachutz veheela vachutz chayyav. af al haalaa. dechol shemmitchayyev al shechitato bachutz im chazar veheelan hu o acher, chayyav:

Nimtza derech hechshero bifnim. baggemara kaamar, tane derech chiyyuvo bifnim peturo bachutz, vederech chiyyuvo bachutz peturo bifnim. kegon shachat haof bifnim veheela bachutz patur. shachat bachutz veheela bachutz chayyav. malak bifnim veheela vachutz chayyav. malak bachutz veheela vachutz patur. nimtza, bemakom shemmitchayyev al haalaato im naaset haavoda harishona bifnim kegon bimlikat penim, patur al haalaato im naaset hammelika vachutz. vederech shemmitchayyev al haalaa im naaset avoda harishona bachutz kegon bishchita, peturo bifnim, im nishchat bifnim veheela vachutz:

Rabbi shimon omer kulei. bemilleteh detanna kamma chassore michassera vehachi katane, vechen hashshochet behema ballayla bifnim veheela vachutz patur, deenah mitkabbelet bifnim, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) beyom zivchachem, velo vallayla, venimtza hazzevach pasul ulefichach eno chayyav al haalaato. aval im shachat ballayla vachutz veheela vachutz chayyav, mippene shehashshechita vachutz ballayla keshera hi lefichach chayyav shetayim, al hashshechita veal hahaalaa. ufaleg rabbi shimon beha vaamar, kol shechayyavin alav bachutz chayyavin al kayyotze vo vifnim sheheelahu vachutz. kelomar, keshem shehashshochet bachutz ballayla veheela vachutz chayyav, kach im shachat bifnim ballayla veheela bachutz chayyav al hahaalaa, chutz mehashshochet of bifnim veheelahu bachutz shehu patur af al pi sheim shachat veheela bachutz chayyav. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hammaale et haaguddot. shel yarak:
Veet hakketziot. kotshim hatteenim bemachteshet veosim otan keen kikkarot gedolot, vehen nikraot ketziot:
Yamtinu. leshon lichluach. vedome lo vaggemara perek lo yachpor [bava vatra daf 18] mitna kashe lakketalim:
Enan bechi yuttan. im yarad alehen tal:
Kol haaguddot. shel yarak:
Shel bet hashshevakim temein. lefi shehammochrim regilim lezallef alehen mayim kede lelachlechan, vehen muchsharin lekabbel tuma, vehayyadayim memashmeshim bahen tamid, hilkach hen bechezkat tuma:

Mippene mashke happe. af al pi sheen mezallefin alehen mayim keshehen lachin, mikkol makom regilim latet alehen mashke hayyotze min happe kede lehasir haavak shealehen, uvo hen muchsharin. veikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi meir makom sheen regilin lelachlecham bemashke happe, lerabbi meir tehorim. uletanna kamma bechol inyan temeim, deaf belachin notnin bahen mayim. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Hakkemachin vehasselatot shel bet hashshevakim temein. lefi shellottim hachittim shellahem kodem sheyyitchanu otan vehen muchsharot, vehayyadayim memashmeshim bahen tamid, lefichach hen bechezkat tuma:
Hachilka. chitta chetusha venechlak kol garin lishnayim:
Teragis. shennechlak kol garin lishlosha:
Tisgi. shennechelak kol garin learbaa:
Bechol makom. afillu shello vevet hashshevakim, shehakkol mezallefin alehem mayim:
Kohen sheyyesh beyadav mumin. vechen befanav o beraglav:

Lo yissa et kappav. sheen hakkohanim rashshain laalot besandelehen ladduchan, veim yesh mumin beraglav yistakkelu bo, umittoch kach yavou lehistakkel beyadav, vehammistakkel bakkohanim keshennosim kappehen enav kehot, [chagiga 16 amud alef], lefi shehashshechina shora ben yedehem:
Istis. tzivo dome lattechelet:

Pua. sharashim adummim shetztzovim bahem adom. umassik baggemara sheim haya dash beiro, kelomar ragil immahem vechullam yodim bammumin sheyyesh bo o batztzeva shebbeyadav, o sherov anshe hair melachtan bechach, muttar, deshuv en mistakkelim bo:
Mi shettaval bannahar. umayim shealav machshirin, shehare leratzon hen:
Vehaya lefanav nahar acher veavar bo. umayim shealav min hannahar hashsheni enan leratzon veenan machshirin:
Tiharu. me hannahar hashsheni, mayim sheheelan immo min hattevila, veen machshirin lo ellu velo ellu:
Dachayo. dachahu:
Leshachro. shehaya chavero shikkor umittoch shichruto dachahu vehippilo vannahar:
Vechen livhemto. shehippil et habbehema beshichruto bannahar, vehayu alav me tevila, veal habbehema mayim leratzon:
Tiharu sheniyyim. shehayu al yede shichrut velo leratzon:
Et harishonim. shehayu leratzon:
Veim kimsachek. dacha et chavero bannahar o et habbehema, gam hashsheniyyim bechi yuttan, dechullehu leratzon ninhu:
Korin parashat shekalim. ki tissa, lehodia sheyyaviu shiklehem baadar, kede sheyyakrivu beechad benisan mitteruma chadasha:
Makdimin lesheavar. korin parashat shekalim bashshabbat shellifne rosh chodesh. vaafillu chal rosh chodesh adar beerev shabbat makdimin lashshabbat sheavra:
Umafsikin bashshabbat habbaa. millomar parasha sheniyya, kede shettikkare parashat zachor bashshabbat hassemucha lefurim, lismoch mechiyyat amalek limchiyyat haman:

Bashshelishit para adumma. lehazehir et yisrael letaher atzmam kede sheyyaasu pischehem betohora. veezo hi shabbat shelishit, kol shessemucha lefurim meachareha. ucheshechal rosh chodesh nisan lihyot beshabbat, haveya la shabbat shelishit shabbat hassemucha lerosh chodesh nisan. kede lismoch azharat tohorat temee metim lifsachim:
Barviit hachodesh hazze. sheshsham parashat happesach:

Lichsidran. leseder hahaftarot. shead henna maftirin meen arba parashiyyot. parashat shekalim ben sheva shanim. parashat zachor pakadti et asher asa lecha amalek. parashat para vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim. parashat hachodesh barishon beechad lachodesh. mikkan vaelach chozer lehafetir meen parashat hayyom:
Lakkol mafsikin. sheen maftirin meen happarasha ella meen hammeora:
Shehashshochet lehedyot kulei. hashshochet kadashim bachutz laachilat hedyot chayyav:

Hammaale vachutz. letzorech hedyot, patur mishshum haalaat chutz. degabbe shechita ketiv dam yechashev laish, afillu hashshochet leish. vegabbe haalaa ketiv laasot oto laAdonai‏, eno chayyav keshemmaalehu vachutz ad sheyyechavven bo laAdonai:
Veshachatu peturim. dichtiv (sham 17) dam yechashev laish hahu, echad velo shenayim:
Veheeluhu chayyavin. dichtiv (sham) ish ish vegomer‏ asher yaale kulei, sheen talmud lomar ish ish, ella lerabbot shenayim sheachazu veevar veheeluhu, shehen chayyavin:
Heela. venoda lo:
Vechazar veheela. meotah behema atzmah, chayyav al kol achat veachat:
Ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach. dichtiv (Bereshit 8) vayyiven noach mizbeach laAdonai. alma afillu bamat yachid shehi vachutz enah haalaa belo mizbeach:
Afillu heela al hassela. dichtiv (Vayikra 17) vezarak hakkohen et haddam al mizbach Adonai‏ petach ohel moed, velo mizbeach bevamat yachid. uvefarashat hammaale vachutz ketiv. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Veen mosifin alehen. divrashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed nammi ikka bittul melacha, dimlechet davar haaved mutteret:

Beyom tov chamishsha. dechol ditfe leh milleta mechavreh, tafe leh gavra. hilkach berashe chodashim uvammoed deikka karban musaf korin arbaa. yom tov deikka bittul melacha korin chamishsha. veyom hakkippurim deanush karet korin shishsha. shabbat dechiyyuv sekila korin shiva:
Hannittazin. shello vechavvana:
Haose tzippor bammayim. shemmaale al pene hammayim retichot kemin avabuot:
Hannittazin. baasiyyat avabuot:
Veet shebbah. dehaynu me avabuot atzman. veit degarse, haose tzinnor bammayim. kemo sheosim hannearim kemin tzinnor shel kane o shel etz chalul, lenattez mimmennu hammayim bitzchok:
Veet shebbah. hammayim hannisharim batztzinnor:
Veellu metammeim umachshirim. shehen atzman mashkin temeim, umetammeim umachshirim keechad:
Zovo shel zav. dichtiv (sham 15) zovo tame hu:
Verukko. vechi yarok vegomer:
Umeme raglav. vezot tihye tumato, vezot, lerabbot meme raglav:
Ureviit dam min hammet. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) kol hannogea bemet benefesh haadam, venefesh haadam hayenu reviit dam, dichtiv (Vayikra 17) ki haddam hu hannefesh:
Vedam hannidda. dichtiv (sham 15) vehaddava beniddatah, ma shezzav mimmenna tame chemotah:
Shichvat zera enah machsheret. sheenah chashuva mashke, deyesh lah shem levay:
Dam hannidda eno machshir. midi dahave addam shel hattachtoniyyot sheggam hu eno machshir:
Dam hammet eno machshir. dechevan shemmet yatza damo mittorat mashke. velet halacha kechad mehanach tannae, ella chullehu metammeim umachshirim ketanna kamma:
Umegisa vikdera. mehappechet bechaf shebbeyadah lattavshil shebbakkedera:
Im hizziu yadeha. mehevel hakkedera, nitmeu yadeha keillu naga vammashke shebbakkedera:
Hayu yadeha temeot. im hizziu yadeha, nitmet hazzea mechamat yadeha, venitmet hakkedera, lefi shehahevel mechabber ben hazzea shebbeyadeha lammashkin shebbakkedera:
Rabbi yose omer im natfu. en hakkedera temea ella im ken natfu tippin min hazzea shebbeyadeha letoch hakkedera. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Hayyayin shebbakkaf tahor. veeno machshir, delo huchshav lihyot mashke ad sheyyeare oto letoch hakkeli. uchemo sheen lo torat mashke leinyan hechsher, kach en lo torat mashke leinyan tuma uleinyan yen nesech:

Leamko bechi yuttan ulerachbo eno vechi yuttan. kesheadam moded amko shel bor bekane, nikkar roshem hammayim bakkane ad kamma hen maggiim, umittoch kach yodea amko, lefichach rotze hu bammashke shebbaroshem. aval lerachbo eno rotze bemashke shebbaroshem. vahalacha kerabbi akiva, shechazar rabbi tarfon lihyot shone chidvarav:
Hakkometz vehallevona. shel minchat nedava. shenehem mattirim et sheyareha laachila, hilkach rabbi elazar poter devae haketarat kol hammattir:
Echad bifnim. techilla veachar kach hashsheni bachutz chayyav. shezze gamar uvo hakkol taluy:
Shene veziche levona. mattirim lechem happanim:

Me hechag. shennitmalleu leshem nissuch hammayim bechag hassukkot, im nissech otan bachutz chayyav, desavar nissuch hammayim bechag deorayta hi, hilkach mechuyyav ala bachutz. veen halacha kerabbi elazar bechulla matnitin, venissuch hammayim bechag lav deorayta hi ella halacha lemoshe missinay:

Sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav. bishyare damim happenimim mayre, vesavar dishyare haddam meakkevim bahem hilkach avoda hi lehitchayyev aleha bachutz, aval bishyare haddam shel mizbeach hachitzon mode rabbi nechemya sheenam ella lemitzva velo leakkev, hilkach hazzorkan bachutz vadday patur. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Hakkol kesherim likrot et hammegilla. hakkol laatoye nashim:
Chutz mecheresh. matnitin rabbi yose hi deamar hakkore velo hishmia leaznav lo yatza:
Rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

En korin et hammegilla. shechayyav adam likrot et hammegilla ballayla velachzor ulekarah bayyom. ukeria shel yom lo tehe ella leachar hanetz hachamma, dichtiv (Ester 9) vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim:
Velo malin. dichtiv (Vayikra 12) uvayyom hashshemini yimmol:

Velo tovlin velo mazzin. dichtiv behazzaa (Bamidbar 19) vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii, vehukkesha tevila lehazzaa. vedavka keshettovel bashshevii amrinan deen tovlin ella bayyom, velo amrinan mishshechashecha bitchillat shevii rauy litbol, af al gav delayla techillat hayyom hu. aval mishsheavar yom shevii muttar litbol ballayla:
Shomeret yom keneged yom. beachad asar yamim shebben nidda lenidda, im raata yom echad shomeret yom mochorato, vetovelet beoto yom atzmo mishshettanetz hachamma:

Mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher. demishsheala ammud hashshachar ikre yom, dichtiv besefer ezra (Nechemya 4) vaanachnu osim bammelacha [vegomer] mealot hashshachar vead tzet hakkochavim, uchetiv batreh vehaya lanu hallayla mishmar vehayyom limlacha. velo amru ad hanetz hachamma ella kede latzet missefek layla, lefi sheen hakkol bekiin kesheyyaale ammud hashshachar:
Bammaamadot bemaase vereshit. shebbishvil hakkarbanot nitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz. veseder keriatan meforash bemassechet taanit beferek acharon:
Berachot ukelalot. im bechukkotay. lehodia sheal iske hachet baa puranut laolam, veyachzeru bitshuva veyinnatzlu mitztzaratam:
Kesidran. beseder parashat hayyom:
Veen olin lahem min hacheshbon. kesheyyaggia yom shabbat yachzeru veyikreu ma shekkaru besheni uvachamishi uveshabbat bemincha:
Shenneemar vaydabber moshe. akkullah matnitin kae, lilmod mikkan shemmitzva likrot bechol hammoed meinyan hammoed:
Nittaz min hatztzavvar. shel behema al habbeged, eno taun kibbus. dichtiv asher yazze, lo amarti ella berauy lehazzaa:
Min hakkeren. shel mizbeach:

Umin hayesod. min hashshirayim haruyim lishshafech al hayesod, veaf al pi shello nishpechu adayin. demeachar shennittan mattan damah en shirayim teunim kibbus, dichtiv asher yazze, perat laze shekkevar huzza middamah:
Ella haddam shennitkabbel bichli. ma taam kaamar, ma taam nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo en taun kibbus, lefi sheen taun kibbus ella haddam shennitkabbel bichli:
Verauy lehazzaya. lemaote kibbel pachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze veachar kach ervan, delo kaddeshe veen teunin kibbus:

Ad shello hufshat en taun kibbus. dichtiv al habbeged, ma beged harauy lekabbel tuma, deen lecha beged katan sheshshemo beged sheeno rauy lekabbel tuma im chashav alav lichli kemot shehu, af kol harauy lekabbel tuma, vead shello hufshat eno rauy lekabbel tuma, umishshehufshat have rauy lekabbel tuma im chashav alav laasot oto michse lemerkava o lechassot bo et hammitta veeno tzarich kitztzua:
Af mishshehufshat. kol zeman shello nitkan lihyot keli:
En taun kibbus. devainan davar hamekabbel tuma sheen mechussar afillu machashava:
Ella mekom haddam. velo chol habbeged:
Verauy lekabbel tuma. veaf al pi shemmechussar machashava. uvilvad shello yehe mechussar melacha. usetama cherabbi yehuda, vechen halacha:
Verauy lechibbus. lemaote keli etz. deaf al gav dimkabbel tuma hu eno rauy lechibbus, devar gerida hu velo bar kibbus:

Hare hakkallim neechalin kachamurim veenan teunin merika. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, im yesh bahen benoten taam hare kallim neechalim kachamurim lifnim min hakkelaim leyom velayla uteunim merika ushetifa ufoslim bemagga. en bahen benoten taam en hakkallim neechalim kachamurim veen bahen merika ushetifa veen poslim bemagga. umatnitin rabbi shimon hi deamar kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushetifa, hilkach keshello natnu taam kadshe kadashim bekadashim kallim en teunim merika ushetifa:
Rakik. pasul, shennaga berakik kasher, uvala hakkasher min happasul:
Hattame sheachal kulei. mishshum diflige rabbi yose haggelili verabbanan betarvayhu vedamu hanach tarte pelugta ahadade, tanninhu gabbe hadade:

Rabbi yose haggelili omer vechulei. keshennitma hagguf veachar kach nitma habbasar kulle alma lo felige dechayyav karet. ki felige, shennitma habbasar veachar kach nitma hagguf, rabbanan it lehu issur kolel, demittoch shechal alav issur tumat hagguf leasro bevasar tahor shehaya muttar bo mittechilla, chal nammi af al habbasar tame veaf al gav shehaya asur veomed, kede sheyyitchayyev alav af mishshum tumat hagguf. verabbi yose haggelili let leh issur chal al issur beissur kolel, veen issur shel tumat hagguf chal al issur shel tumat basar. veen halacha kerabbi yose haggelili:
Vetahor sheachal tame patur. min hakkaret. vesofeg et haarbaim mishshum (Vayikra 7) vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel:
Sheeno chayyav ella al tumat hagguf. kedichtiv (sham) vetumato alav venichreta, betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber:

En porsin al shema. asara shebbau levet hakkeneset achar shekkaru tzibbur et shema, omed echad veomer kaddish uvarchu uveracha rishona shellifne keriat shema. porsin, leshon perusa, kelomar chatzi davar, mishshete berachot shellifne keriat shema omer beracha achat:
Veen ovrin lifne hatteva. sheliach tzibbur:
Veen nosin kappehen. levarech birkat kohanim:

Veen korin battora. betzibbur. vechol hane en naasim befachot measara, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) venikdashti betoch bene yisrael, kol davar shebbikdushsha lo yehe befachot measara, ketiv hacha betoch bene yisrael, uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 15) hibbadlu mittoch haeda hazzot, ma lehallan asara, sheen eda pechuta measara, af kan asara:

Veen osin maamad umoshav. lemet, keshennosin et hammet lekavro hayu yoshvim sheva peamim lichvod hammet, veomrim al kol perek uferek shel hesped imdu yekarim amodu, shevu yekarim shevu. uvevatzir measara lav orach ara:
Birkat avelim. birkat rechava. shehayu omrim beracha keneged avelim, uveracha keneged hammenachamim kulei, kedimforash beferek kamma dichtubbot [daf 8]:
Vetanchume avelim. omdim beshura keshechozrin min hakkever umenachamin et haavelim, veen shura pechuta measara:
Uvirkat chatanim. sheva berachot sheomrim lechatan:
Veen mezammenin. kevan devae lememar nevarech elohenu, batzir measara lav orach ara:
Vehakkarkaot. shel hekdesh, habba lifdotan tzarich asara veechad mehen kohen, daasara kohane ketuvim befarashat hekdeshot, shelosha baarachin ushelosha babbehema vearbaa bakkarkaot:

Veadam kayyotze bahen. im amar damay alay, shamin oto keeved, veeved itkash lakkarkaot, dichtiv (Vayikra 25) vehitnachaltem otam livnechem. vechi hechi divkarkaot bainan asara vechad minnayhu kohen, hachi nammi baadam:
Bemakom kadosh. baazara:

Ushevirat keli cheres bemakom kadosh. devatar dichtiv techabbes bemakom kadosh, ketiv ucheli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver, itkash shevirat keli cheres lechibbus, ma kibbus bemakom kadosh af shevirat keli cheres bemakom kadosh:
Ze chomer. akkibbus kae:

Shiva mashkin hen. lefi shenneemar betumat ochalim (Vayikra 11) mikkol haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim yitma, en li ella mayim, minnayin lerabbot hayyayin vehashshemen vehechalav vehaddevash vehaddam vehattal, talmud lomar vechol mashke asher yishshate. vei vechol mashke, yachol me tutim me rimmonim ushear kol me ferot, talmud lomar mayim, ma mayim meyuchadim sheen lahem shem levay, af hayyayin vehashshemen vehechalav vehaddevash vehaddam vehattal sheen lahem shem levay, yatzu me tutim me rimmonim ushear kol me ferot sheyyesh lahem shem levay, udevash devorim en lo shem levay, didvash setam ikkere. veod shaninu vattosefta deshabbat perek 9, minnayin ledam shehu mashke, shenneemar (Bamidbar 23) vedam chalalim yishte. minnayin leyayin shehu mashke, shenneemar (Devarim 32) vedam enav tishte chamer. minnayin lidvash shehu mashke, shenneemar (sham) vayyenikehu devash missela. minnayin leshemen shehu mashke, shenneemar (yeshaya ko) mishte shemanim. minnayin lechalav shehu mashke, shenneemar (Shoftim 4) vattiftach et novd hechalav vattashkehu. minnayin letal shehu mashke, shenneemar (sham 6) vayyimetz tal min haggizza melo hassefel mayim. minnayin ledimot haayin shehu mashke, shenneemar (tehillim 80) vattashkemo bidmaot shalish. minnayin leme haaf shehu mashke, shenneemar (yirmeya 9) veafappenu yizzelu mayim:
Devash tzira tahor. dela chashiv mashke, veeno metamme veeno machshir:

Umuttar baachila. delo tema hoil vehatztzira sheretz haof hu vetame, haddevash hayyotze mimmennu nammi yehe tame, desalka datach amena dedavka devash devorim rabbeye kera lehettera sheen lo shem levay, aval devash tzeraim sheyyesh lo shem levay lo yehe muttar, ka mashma lan devash tzira tahor umuttar. demippene ma amru devash devorim muttar, mippene shemmachnisot otan legufan veenan mematztzot oto miggufan, devash tzeraim nammi machnisot oto legufan veen mematztzot oto miggufan:

Hare ze zav gamur. vechayyav bekarban. deviriyyot tala rachamana, dichtiv tumato bezovo, tumato teluya bezovo veenah teluya beyome. umihu behifsik yom bentayim kaamre vet hillel leel delo have zav gamur veen hariyyot mitztarfot, lo shena leinyan tuma kegon raa shete reiyyot bilvad behafesakat yom bentayim, lo shena leinyan karban kegon raa shalosh reiyyot:
Shennaflu alehem mashkim. temeim:
Im rabbu. me geshamim al hammashkim hahem, bittelum vetiharum:
Hotzian kede sheyyerdu alehem geshamim. deachshevinhu laggeshamim:
Af al pi sherabbu temein. denitmeu haggeshamim atzman:

Balu mashkin temeim. kegon shehaetzim neguvim mibbachutz uvetochan mashkin beluin, af al pi shehotzian kede sheyyerdu alehen geshamim deachshevinhu laggeshamim, afillu hachi tehorin, delo nagu vemashkin temein, shehare valu:

Lo yassikem ella veyadayim tehorot. shello yetammeu hayyadayim et me haggeshamim shehuchshevu veyachzeru vitammeu et hattannur, demashke metamme cheli. aval beyadayim tehorot yachol lehassikam battannur, vehattannur tahor, velo amrinan desof mashke tame habbalua latzet mechamat hahessek, divetzim shehaesh sholetet bahen veneechaz bahen haur kalin hammashkim letochan, veen yotzim lachutz keshemmassikan battannur:
Im hayu lachin. etzim hallalu shebbalu mashkin temein, umechamat lachutan yatzu mashkin atzman mehen, veim otan mashkim paltu mashke hattame habbalua, verabbu mashkin shemmeatzman al mashke habbalua:
Tehorin. shebbittelu otan. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Moshchim et hammayim. shettachat ilan ze, leilan acher, delekka tircha. aval lo yashke kol hassade. uvisde bet habbaal ayre, delo pasde, shemme geshamim maspikin lo, ella shekkeshemmashkin oto have harevacha tefe:
Shello shatu. delo pasde:

Baze uvaze. afillu lo shatu, vaafillu sede habbaal, demishshum harevacha sharu chachamim. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, distam matnitin mashkin bet hashshelachin dilel kevateh. umihu sade lacha shehakkarka shellah kemo tit muttar lehashekotah bammoed afillu lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, dechizraim sheshshatu lifne hammoed damu:

Veechad sheera letocho roteach. middichtiv (Vayikra 7) ucheli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver, desamach yishshaver etzel bo, velo chetiv veim bichli cheres tevushshal yishshaver, lemidrash, im nivla bo mikkol makom yishshaver:

Kadashim kallim enan teunim merika ushetifa. mode rabbi shimon devau hageala berotchin, shehare hattaam habbalua naase notar ufolto leachar zeman behetter im lo yagilennu. umittorat merika ushetifa hu dimmaet rabbi shimon lekadashim kallim, dimrika ushetifa dekadshe kadashim tzarich sheyyihye bemayim velo beyayin velo bemazug, veim bishshel bemiktzat keli taun merika ushetifa kol hakkeli, utzerichim merika bechammin ushetifa betzonen. veillu kadashim kallim lerabbi shimon magilan afillu beyayin vaafillu bemazug rotchim, delo kafdinan ella lehageil issur hannivla, veen tzarich lehageil ella mekom habbishshul bilvad, veachar hahagala en tzarich shetifa betzonen, dechol hanach gezerat hakkatuv ninhu bechattat uvekadshe kadashim, velo bekadashim kallim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon. dedavka teruma memaatinan mikkol hane daamaran, dichtiv yochal otah, vetanya, otah perat litruma sheen lah torat merika ushetifa kekadashim. aval kadashim kallim shavin hen lekadshe kadashim lechol torat merika ushetifa. uveferush merika ushetifa nechleku tannaim babberayta, yesh sheomer merika hageala bechammin ushetifa betzonen. veyesh mi sheomer merika ushetifa shetehen betzonen levatar hageala, keditnan lekamman besamuch, ella shemmerika kimrikat hakkos ushetifa kishtifat hakkos, shezze mibbachutz veze mibbifnim, kelomar shetifa mibbachutz umerika mibbifnim. vahalacha kedivre haomer merika bechammin ushetifa betzonen:

Yevashshel bo et kol haragel. belo merika ushetifa, ulevassof yimrok veyishtof. lefi shekkol yom naasa giul lachavero, demittoch sheshshelamim merubbim baregel en balua shellahen naase notar, shehare zeman shelamim lishne yamim, vechi mevashshel beh shelamim haidna vahadar mevashshel beh shelamim lemachar mishshelamim shennishchatu beyom hammochorat, polet ma shebbala etmol uvolea min haacharonot, nimtza sheeno va lide notar:

Vachachamim omrim ad zeman achila. shello yehe ben sof habbishshul litchillat merika ushetifa ella zeman achila bilvad velo yoter mizze. dichtiv umorak veshuttaf, uchetiv kol zachar bakkohanim yochal otah, velamma semachan hakkatuv, lomar lecha shemmamtin zeman achila bilvad vahadar avid leh merika ushetifa bo vayyom miyyad. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haaskela. 249 belaaz. vehi asuya cheen sevacha vetzolin alav tzeli:
Magilan. bechammin:
Ulehekter chalavim veevarim. motre tamid shel ben haarbayim, dichtiv behu (Vayikra 6) hi haola al mokdah al hammizbeach kol hallayla:
Ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato bayyom kasher kol hayyom. laatoye siddur shete beziche levona shennotnim al lechem happanim:
Vedavar shemmitzvato vallayla kasher kol hallayla. laatoye achilat pesachim shekkasher kol hallayla. velo amru chachamim ad chatzot ella kede leharechik et haadam min haavera:
Haroe reiyya achat shel zov. zov ba mibbasar hammet vedome leloven betza hammuzeret. veshichvat zera ba mibbasar sheeno met ukeshura cheloven betza sheenah muzeret:

Bet shammay omrim keshomeret yom. deaf al pi sheenah zava gemura ad shalosh reiyyot, mikkol makom biriyya achat osa mishkav umoshav. kemo chen zav, af al pi sheeno naase zav gamur ad shalosh reiyyot, mikkol makom biriyya achat ose mishkav umoshav:
Uvet hillel omrim kevaal keri. veeno ose mishkav umoshav, veen hariyya metammea vemassa, ella vemagga:

Raa achat uvashsheni hifsik uvashshelishi raa shetayim. dechi raa shete reiyyot beyom echad o vishne yamim retzufim, tzarich limnot shiva nekiyyim, ufatur min hakkarban. veim raa shalosh reiyyot beyom echad o vishlosha yamim retzufim, tzarich limnot shiva nekiyyim vechayyav bekarban. detanya, mana hakkatuv shetayim ukerao tame, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) zav mibbesaro zovo tame hu. shalosh ukerao tame, (sham) vezot tihye tumato bezovo rar besaro et zovo o hechtim besaro mizzovo tumato hiv, ha chetzad, shetayim letuma veshalosh lekarban. aval hazzava im raata reiyyot rabbot beyom echad o vishne yamim belo et niddatah, shomeret yom echad binkiyyut utehora laerev. veim raata shalosh reiyyot bishlosha yamim retzufim, tzericha limnot shiva nekiyyim vechayyevet bekarban. degabbe zava ketiv (sham) veishsha ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim belo et niddatah, yamim shenayim, rabbim shelosha, tala hakkatuv hazzav biriyyot, vehazzava beyamim. vehasheta kaamar sheim raa hazzav shalosh reiyyot ella shehifsik yom echad ben reiyya rishona lashshetayim haacharonot:
Bet shammay omrim zav gamur. vechayyav bekarban kevaal shalosh reiyyot:
Uvet hillel omrim. bittel hayyom hattahor et hariyya harishona, veen kan ella shete reiyyot haacharonot, ufatur min hakkarban:
Modim bet shammay baze sheeno zav gamur. devittel hayyom hattahor shehifsik, et hariyya harishona, kedaamaran:
Al ma nechleku al haroe shetayim vechulei‏ bet shammay omrim zav gamur. dehoil venizkak lisfirat shiva kesheraa shetayim battechilla, bittela reiyya et yom hattahor, veyesh beyado shalosh reiyyot:
Uvechullan. bechol hanneechalim:

Rashshaim hakkohanim leshannot baachilatan. kegon leachlan tzeluyin mevushshalin ushelukin. divmattenot kehunna ketiv (sham 18) lecha netattim lemashcha, ligdulla kederech shehammelachim ochlim tzali shaluk umevushshal uvematammim vetavlin:
Shello yavi et hatteruma lide fesul. lefi shehattavlin shebbalu taam hakkodashim im yavou lide notar hare hen beazhara mishshum taam hakkodashim shebbalua bahen:
Maase amnon vetamar nikra umittargem. velo chayshinan likareh dedavid. vehu, delo ketiv amnon ben david, kidvainan lememar lekamman:
Maase egel harishon nikra umittargem. velo chayshinan likara deyisrael:
Maase egel hashsheni. min vayyomer moshe el aharon ad vayyar moshe et haam vegomer, ufasuk vayyiggof Adonai‏ et haam, kol elu nikraim velo mittargemin, mishshum yekara deaharon:
Birkat kohanim. nikraim velo mittargemin mishshum deit beh yissa Adonai‏ panav elecha, shello yomru hakkadosh baruch hu nose panim, vehen enan yodim shekkeday hen yisrael laset lahem panim:

Maase david veamnon. lo nikraim bahafetara, velo mittargemin, kol otan pesukim shekkatuv bahem amnon ben david. aval otan shenneemar bahen amnon setam, ha amrinan leel maase amnon vetamar nikra umittargem:
En maftirin bammerkava. dilma ate leshayyole uleiyyune bah:
Verabbi yehuda mattir. vahalacha kemoto:
En maftirin behoda et yerushalayim (Yechezkel 16), mishshum yikra dirushalayim. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Chalev haishsha metamme. machshir lekabbel tuma. veim nitma o shehaishsha temea, metamme chedin mashkin temeim, detorat mashke yesh bo:
Leratzon. hannechlav bechavvana:
Veshello leratzon. kegon chalav hannotef middaddeha:
Sheeno meyuchad ella liktannim. usetameh la chashiv kulle hay:
Sheddam maggefatah tame. dehayyotze mimmakkatah tame, dedame ledam chalalim shekkaruy mashke, dema li katla kulla, ma li katla palga:
Sheddam maggefatah tahor. dedam behema lo ikkere dam chalalim, degabbe adam ketiv:

Salle zetim vaanavim yochichu. shehassochatan lirfua tame, veaf al pi chen leratzon temeim, shello leratzon tehorim. af hechalav, af al pi shehacholev lirfua tame, keshennechlav shello leratzon din hu sheyyihye tahor: veshello leratzon tehorim. sheen hayyotze min hazzetim vaanavim chashuv mashke ad sheyyetze leratzon:
Kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah. kegon sheera bah pesul kodem zerika, delo hayta lah sheat hetter lammizbeach:
Orah lakkohanim. hoil vezacha hammizbeach bivsarah shehare cheshera hi:

Veechad olat haishsha. dichtiv vehakkohen hammakriv et olat ish, en li ella olat ish, olat nashim vaavadim minnayin, talmud lomar or haola, ribba. im ken lamma neemar olat ish, perat lematpis olato levedek habbayit, shehaor kadosh:
Kach hem kodmim laachila. akkullehu divne achila kae, kegon chattat leasham, veasham letoda, vetoda lishlamim:
Shelamim. shel karban emesh:

Vachachamim omrim kulei. vahalacha kachachamim. vetadir umekuddash, kegon dam olat tamid vedam chattat omdim, ze tadir veze mekuddash mimmennu, deha amaran dam chattat kodem ledam ola mippene shehu meratztze. ha milleta mibbaya baggemara velo ifshita, venire detadir kodem:
Hachovet al hashshelach. makke vaor achar rechitzato kede lenaaro min hammayim:
Hashshelach. haor kemot shehu keshemmafshitim oto min habbehema [bereshit 37] nikra shelach. targum vayyafshitu, veashlachu:

Shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu im hatztzoa. mitkavven sheyyetzu hammayim im hallichluch shennitchabber bahen, lefichach machshir ma shennittaz mimmennu vaafillu shehu vetoch hammayim. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Kede tevila vesippug. kede sheyyitbol vikannach atzmo achar tevila. ufachot mishshiur ze, lo have hefsek vela chashiva ella reiyya achat:
O achat merubba chishtayim. shehaya ben hatechalat hariyya lesof hariyya kede tevila vesippug, vehaya roe tamid belo hefsek:
Leda kamma mayim yesh bo. rotze bammashke shebbaroshem, kedaamaran, lefichach have bechi yuttan. aval leda im yesh bo mayim, en tzarich roshem shel mashke:
Veshebbaeven. kelomar, shebbaeven nammi tehorim, sheen machshirim:
Uvelalan sheyyenuggevu. balal kol happerot bemayim, shekkesheyyihyu hammayim mefuzzarim bechol happerot, yitnaggevu yoter mehera:
Vachachamim omrim enan bechi yuttan. vahalacha kachachamim:
En orotehen lakkohanim. ella nisrafim im oran:
Lo raiti or yotze levet hasserefa. leachar shehufshat im nimtzet terefa, af al pi sheppesul ze haya vo kodem hefshet, hoil velo nikkar ad leachar hefshet:

Shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa. ha kamashma lan rabbi akiva daafillu bechor baal mum hannishchat bammedina al mumo, velo hittiro hakkatuv ella baachila kedichtiv bisharecha tochalennu, aval im met oro asur vetaun kevura, veashmeinan rabbi akiva dehecha dela hukkar terefato ad leachar hefsheto, sharya shechitato vehefsheto leoro, keillu nizrak damo bammikdash:
Yeotu hakkohanim beoro. veeno nisraf:
En lo rainu reaya. shemma lo era beyamav sheyyimmatze terefa leachar hefshet, veim era userafuhu hu lo raa:

Ella yotze levet hasserefa. hoil vekodem hefshet ba. vahalacha kerabbi akiva bivchor baal mum keshehittiro mumche. aval lo hittiro mumche, lo. vahalacha kachachamim bivchor tamim, devasar bikvura vehaor bisrefa:
Hameare mecham lecham. hachi nammi ayre shemmashkin shebbakkeli haelyon shemmeare mimmennu, tehorim. veshebbichli tachton shemmeare letocho, hen temein:
Mitztzonen lecham tame. shettachton hacham maale hevel laelyon hatztzonen umetammeo, sheheanan haole min hacham kemashke hu chashuv:

Vechocho shel tachton yafe. shechummo gadol mishshel elyon. veen halacha kerabbi shimon, shekkevan shehaelyon cham, af al pi shehattachton yoter cham mimmennu, en peullato shel tachton nikkeret baelyon veeno metammeo:
Shehu mitchallek. laachilat kohanim:

Motar rekike minchot yisrael. minchat maafe shebbaa challot urekikin. challot bollan, urekikin moshchan. veamar rabbi shimon bemassechet menachot [daf 75] moshchan kemin 30 [kaf yevanit], ushear hashshemen neechol lakkohanim:
Motar rekike minchat kohanim. deminchat kohanim kullah kalil, hashshemen shetztzaf al gabbah venotar sheeno nivla bah, sorfim oto bifne atzmo:
Umotar minchat kohen hammashiach. lefi sheshshamnah merubba, shelosha luggin leissaron, umittoch shehi afuya techilla en shamnah nivla biftiteha vetzarich lehaketir hammotar bifne atzmo:
Sheen mitnaddevim shamen. lefichach lo yaale al datecha sheyyehe hashshemen hammitchallek o hanniktar nedava:

Rabbi tarfon omer mitnaddevim shamen. bifne atzmo. veen pachot millog. venisraf bifne atzmo. vahalacha kerabbi tarfon. vechen halacha shemmitnaddevim yayin bifne atzmo veen mitnaddevim pachot mishshelosha luggin, vezorkin oto al gabbe haishshim venisraf sham. veaf al gav dehu mechabbe esh hammaaracha verachamana amar lo tichbe, hoil veeno mitkavven lechabbot share, dichrabbi shimon kayma lan dedavar sheeno mitkavven muttar. velo have pesik resheh, deefshar shettihye haesh gedola vachazaka utenatztzeach et hayyayin velo yechabbenna:

Pochato. dichli mattachot eno tahor mittumato benekev kol shehu ella benekev gadol. umihu achar sheppechato, makkish alav bekurnas umechabbero kede sheyyachazor shem keli alav. devishat merika tzarich sheyyihye keli:
Veellu lo metammeim. afillu yatzu min hattame, kegon min hazzav vechayyotze vo. dichtiv bezovo tame hu, hu tame veen zea velecha serucha urei shello temeim:
Vehallecha serucha. hayyotzet min hammursa. vehu haddin berokek lecha serucha:
Vehari. tzoa. kemo vehari:
Vedam hayyotze immahem. im hallecha vehari:
Umashke ven shemona. kol mashke sheyyatza minnefel shennolad ben shemona chodashim, kegon damo verukko umeme raglav. lefi shebben shemona chay hare hu cheeven:
Chutz middamo. shemmetamme chedam shel ben keyama. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Af al pi sheyyotzin nekiyyim. shemmotzi otan derech bet hari tzelulim kemo shehayu kesheshshetaan, afillu hachi en machshirin, hoil veyatzu derech bet hari:
Rabbi eliezer metamme vaellu. demashkin hen chashuvin, umetammein umachshirin. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Chalev hazzachar tahor. dela chashiv mashke. vechen halacha:
Dam chattat. taun kibbus. kedichtiv (Vayikra 7) vaasher yazze middamah vegomer‏ techabbes bemakom kadosh:
Shenneemar bemakom kadosh teachel. uvehahu inyana ketiv:
Veechad happenimit. sheddaman taun hazzaya bifnim sheenan neechalot:
Shenneemar torat hachattat. beresha dehahu inyana ketiv:
Tora achat lechol hachattaot. vedavka chattat behema. aval dam chattat haof eno taun kibbus, divhahu inyana tishshachet hachattat ketiv, perat lechattat haof sheenah nishchetet:

Kol hannitztzok tahor. im meare mikkeli tahor lichli tame, ma shebbaelyon tahor, denitztzok eno chibbur. chutz mehane dachashiv, mippene shessoldim laachorehem, keshehakkilluach nifsak, chozer hannishar lemala:

Middevash hazzifim. it dimfarshe devash tov vechashuv, shemmittoch chashivuto mezayyefin oto umearvin bo fesolet. veit deamre, al shem mekomo shebba mizzif. kemo bevo hazzifim vayyomru leshaul (tehillim ned):
Vehatztzappachat. maachol asuy mikkemach udevash vehu rach kol kach sheyyecholim lehatztziko. vedome lo ketzappichit bidvash [shemot 16]:
Hammikpa. tavshil sheeno lo rach velo kashe ella kafuy, karuy mikpa:
Shel gerisin. polim techunot ugerusot berechayim:
Veshel polim. shelemot sheenan gerusot berechayim:

Mippene shehi soledet laachoreha. keshehakkilluach nifsak, chozer oto ammud hashshotet shehaya ketzato vammashkin temein shebbakkeli hattachton venimshach lemala lammashkin shebbakkeli haelyon hattahor, umetamme chol ma shebbakkeli haelyon:
Heekel. makom beshule hassefina shemmitkabbetzim sham hammayim hannichnasim bassedakim shel sefina:
Im nier. lehasir hammayim shealehen. kemo hamenaer tallito:

Letzarfah. levadkah im hammayim nichnasim letochah im lav. perush acher, lechazzekah ulechasmah. lefi shekkeshehi vayyabbasha, nivkaat meeleha, umachnisim otah bayyam kede shettishre vammayim veyissatmu vikkueha usedakeha:
Masmer laggeshamim letzarfo. lechazzeko ulechasmo, kesheyyavou alav mayim leachar shennitlabben baesh:
Ud. etz shemmiktzato achla haesh:
Veen mafshilin. godlim ufotlim. vehu haddin lechol shear melachot, ella hafeshalat chavalim tzarich makom rechav yadayim, uvet hakkeneset bayit gadol hu verauy lechach vahave orcheh:
Kappandarya. lekatztzer hillucho derech bet hakkeneset. uleshon kappandarya, addemakkifna dare aul beha, kelomar beod sheani tzarich lehakkif shurot battim akatztzer mahalachi veekkanes derech kan:

Mippene agmat nefesh. sheyyizkeru yeme binyano veyittenu lev livnoto im yuchelu, o yevakkeshu alav rachamim sheyyachzor. lefichach en asur ella lilkot asavim ulehaachil labbehema o leabbedam [legamre], aval lilkot ulehannicham bimkomam muttar, deikka agmat nefesh:
Orot kadashim kallim labbealim. dichtiv or haola vegomer, ma ola kadshe kadashim af kol kadshe kadashim:
Orot kadshe kadashim. chattaot vaashamot: lakkohanim. kedimfaresh taama veazel:

En hammizbeach mochiach. kelomar, en lecha lomar mizbeach yochiach shezzacha bivsar haola velo zacha baor, veaf atta al titma bekadshe kadashim sheaf al pi shezzachu kohanim bivsaran lo yizku veoran. en zo hochacha, sheen lammizbeach or bechol makom. aval bakkohanim matzinu shezzachu beor haola, vekal vachomer sheyyizku beorot kadshe kadashim:
Haishut. tinshemet. vehi beriyya sheen lah enayim, umafsedet et hassadot:
Uvisde hallavan. shechorshin vezorin oto litvua veen bo ilanot:
Bisde hailan kedarko. demafsede tefe, ulehefsed merubbe chashshu. lefichach chofer gumma kedarko vetole bah metzuda:

Shello chedarko. noetz shippud bakkarka bechozek umenaanea elach vaelach umotzi, venimtzet gumma naaset meeleha. aval lo al yede chafira. vahalacha kachachamim. uvisde lavan hassemucha lisde ilan, chofer kedarko, shemma yetzu missede lavan veyachrivu hailanot:
Umekarin et happirtza. mesadderin et haavanim zo al zo kederech binyan, veeno tach betit. uvefirtza shel ginna mayre, aval kotel chatzer shennafal, bone kedarko, mippene haggannavim:
En damah taun kibbus. dichtiv asher yazze middamah, middam keshera velo middam pesula:
Sheat hakkosher. lizrika:
Shellana. shellan damah:

Veshekkibbelu fesulin. garsinan. velo garsinan veshezzarku, deha afillu chattat keshera shennittaz damah al gabbe habbeged leachar zerikat haddam eno taun kibbus, kidamrinan asher yazze, perat leze shekkevar huzza:
Hammaftir bannavi. mi sheragil lehafetir bannavi, tikkenu chachamim sheyyehe hu pores al shema barabbim:
Vehu over lifne hatteva. lehotzi et harabbim bikdushshat hashshem battefilla, hoil umamtzi et atzmo lehafetir dahave davar sheeno kevodo, tikkenu lo et zo lichvodo:
Veim haya katan. sheeno yachol laavor lifne hatteva, velo lifros al shema:
Aviv o rabbo. ovrim lifne hatteva:
Al yado. bishvilo:

Hakkore et hammegilla lemafrea lo yatza. dichtiv (Ester 9) vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim, ma asiyyat hayyamim i efshar lemafrea, dei efshar sheyyehe chamishsha asar kodem arbaa asar, af zechira shehi keriat hammegilla, lemafrea lo:
Keraah al pe. lo yatza. ketiv hacha nizkarim, uchetiv hatam (Shemot 17) ketov zot zikkaron bassefer:
Keraah targum bechol lashon lo yatza. hachi kaamar, ivri shekkeraah targum veeno mevin bilshon targum, o bechol shear lashon sheeno mevin, lo yatza:
Aval korin otah lalloazot belaaz. beoto lashon shehem mevinim. uvilvad shettehe ketuva beoto lashon, shello yehe kore al pe:
Vehalloez sheshshama ashshurit yatza. vivanit hare hu keashshurit ledin ze. ella shekkevar avad oto leshon hayyevani venishtakkach kidchatvinan leel:

targum: Ashlatteh beovade yedach kola shavita techot rigloy:

rashi: Tzone vaalafim. tzon uvakar, kemo (Devarim 7:13) "shegar alafecha". tzone leshon peulla hu, kemo "ugederot letzonaachem" (Bamidbar 32:24), avbyyldytz belaaz. yesh midreshe aggada veenam mityashevin lefi hammikraot:
targum: An vetore chulehon ulechod beire chakla:
Tzippere shemaya venune yama velivyatan dechalif israte yama:
Adonai elaha ribbonana kema telil umeshabbach shemach bechula ara:
La takshun libbechon hech bematzuta hech yoma denasetun elaha bemadbera:

rashi: Bechanuni. chinnam:
Gam rau fooli. bemitzrayim (shemot z:g-yab:lv):
targum: Di nasiu yati avahatchon bachanu yati lechod chamon ovadai:

rashi: Arbaim shana. katti vahem, ravti immahem, leshon "nokta nafshi bechayyai" (Iyov 10:1). nilchamti vam arbaim shana lahamitam bammidbar, ki amarti toe levav hem:
targum: Arbein shenin measet bedara bemadbera vaamaret ama detavata belibbehon hinun veinun la yadeu orchi:

rashi: El menuchati. leeretz yisrael velirushalayim asher keratim menucha, shenneemar (Tehillim 132:14) "zot menuchati ade ad":
targum: Dekaymet bitkof rugezi im yaalun leniach bet makdeshi:

Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Humility 2:31-4: And further, concerning his punishment in the World to Come, they said in Tractate Rosh Hashanah, first chapter (17a): but the Sadducees, the informers, and the heretics who denied the Torah, who denied the resurrection of the dead, who separated from the ways of the community, and who spread their terror in the land of the living, and so on, descend to Gehinnom and are judged there for generations of generations, as it is said (Isaiah 66:24), "and they shall go out and see the corpses of the men who transgressed against Me," and so on - Gehinnom ceases but they do not cease, as it is said (Psalms 49:15), "and their form is for Sheol to consume," and so on. And we say further there, "and who spread their terror in the land of the living" - Rav Chisda said, this is a communal leader who casts excessive fear upon the community not for the sake of Heaven. Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav, any communal leader who casts excessive fear upon the community not for the sake of Heaven does not merit to see a son who is a Torah scholar, as it is said (Job 37:24), "therefore men fear Him; He does not regard any who are wise of heart" - to this point. It follows that the punishment of one who pursues authority has punishment in this world and punishment in the World to Come without measure, as explained.

And haughtiness of spirit removed Jeroboam son of Nevat from the World to Come - and so they said in Sanhedrin (101b): Rav Nachman said, the haughtiness of spirit that was in Jeroboam drove him from the World to Come, as it is said (I Kings 12:26), "and Jeroboam said in his heart, now the kingdom will return to the house of David; if this people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD... and they shall return," and so on, "to Rehoboam king of Judah" - he said, it is a tradition that sitting in the [Temple] courtyard is only for the kings of the house of David alone; when they see him sitting and me standing, they will say, this one is king and that one is not king, and they shall kill me - and everyone shall go to him [Rehoboam]. Immediately (ibid. 12:28), "and the king took counsel, and made two golden calves" - he said to them, it is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem - to this point, relevant here.

And moreover, even a Torah scholar, if he is proud of his wisdom, his wisdom departs and he forgets his learning, as we say in Pesachim (66b): Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav, whoever is arrogant - if he is a prophet, his prophecy departs from him, and if he is a sage, his wisdom departs. If he is a sage, from where do we know this? From Hillel - for the master said, he began to taunt them with words and said to them, what caused you that I had to come up from Babylon and become your prince? The laziness that was in you, that you did not serve the two great men of the generation, Shemaya and Avtalyon - and he said to them, this halachah I have heard and forgotten. If he is a prophet, that his prophecy departs, from where do we know this? From Devorah, as it is said (Judges 5:7), "the villages ceased," and so on, "until I, Devorah, arose," and so on, and it is written (ibid. 5:12), "awake, awake, Devorah" - to this point.

And so they said in the Midrash on the verse (Job 9:7), "who commands the sun and it does not rise" - our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said (Yalkut, Job, remez 904): and so you find with the greatest of the prophets - because he said (Deuteronomy 1:17), "and the matter that is too hard for you," the Holy One, blessed be He, said to him, by your life, even a ruling that women know, you do not know, as it is said (Numbers 27:5), "and Moses brought their case before the LORD," and it is written (ibid. 27:7), "the daughters of Zelophehad speak rightly" - to this point.

And further we say in Kiddushin (49b), concerning what we say, ten kabin of haughtiness of spirit descended to the world - nine were taken by Elam and one by the whole rest of the world - and it raised a difficulty: but did haughtiness of spirit not descend to Babylon? And so on, and it raised a further difficulty: but the master has said, the sign of haughtiness of spirit is poverty, and poverty is [found] only in Babylon? What is "poverty"? Poverty of Torah, as it is written (Song of Songs 8:8), "we have a little sister" - Rabbi Yochanan said, this is Elam, which merited to learn but did not merit to teach - to this point.

And moreover, even one who has just begun to study and is proud of it, saying that he is a Torah scholar, his punishment is great, as we say in Tractate Bava Batra (98a): Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav, whoever is proud of a Torah scholar's cloak while not being a Torah scholar is not admitted into the enclosure of the Holy One, blessed be He - it is written here (Habakkuk 2:5), "a proud man, and he shall not abide [yinveh]," and it is written there (Exodus 15:13), "to Your holy abode [neveh]" - to this point. And it appears to me that this is measure for measure: just as he drove the Shechinah from his own house, so, when his soul ascends above, it shall be driven from the enclosure of the Holy One, blessed be He - for the Shechinah dwells only in a broken heart, and this is what they said in the Tikkunim (page 22b), that one must make a fine dwelling for it in his heart - meaning, that he be lowly and not angry - for once he is proud, the Shechinah flees from him, since he has given dominion to the maidservant in the place of her mistress - and therefore "he shall not abide" - just as there was no dwelling for the Holy One, blessed be He, in him, so there shall be no dwelling for his soul in the World to Come.

And among the things that delay the redemption is haughtiness of spirit, as it is written in Sanhedrin (98a): Ze'iri said in the name of Rabbi Chanina, the son of David does not come until the haughty of spirit cease from Israel, as it is said (Zephaniah 3:11), "for then I will remove from your midst your proudly exultant ones, and you shall no longer be haughty on My holy mountain," and it is written, "and I will leave in your midst a poor and humble people, and they shall take refuge in the name of the LORD." And Rabbi Moshe of Coucy, peace be upon him, wrote in Klal 5, siman 64, concerning this matter - these are its words: and it does not mean an actually poor people, for it is written (Isaiah 60:9), "for the islands shall wait for Me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your children from afar, their silver and gold with them" - but rather it means a humble people, and so Onkelos translated it, "a humble people" - to this point.

And after we have spoken of the disgrace of pride and its punishment, let us speak of the punishment of one who is angry - for anger comes only from pride of heart, for if his heart were broken and crushed, certainly he would not become angry and would not respond to his own disgrace, as we say at the end of our prayer, in "my God, guard my tongue from evil," "and to those who curse my soul, let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all" - and likewise in several matters, the punishments for anger are equal to the punishments for pride, such as that the angry person forgets his learning, as shall be explained.

In Nedarim (22a) we say: Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonatan, whoever becomes angry, all kinds of Gehinnom rule over him, as it is said (Ecclesiastes 11:10), "and remove anger from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh, for childhood and youth are vanity" - and there is no "evil" except Gehinnom, as it is said (Proverbs 16:4), "and even the wicked for the day of evil" - and moreover, intestinal ailments rule over him, as it is said (Deuteronomy 28:65), "and the LORD shall give you there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and languishing of soul" - what is a thing that fails the eyes and languishes the soul? Say, this is intestinal ailments. And the Rosh, of blessed memory, explained: "fails the eyes," that his illness is prolonged and he constantly looks forward to being healed - to this point.

And we say further there: Rabbah bar Rav Huna said, every angry person - even the Shechinah is not considered important compared to him, as it is said (Psalms 10:4), "the wicked, in the haughtiness of his anger, will not seek Him," and so on. Rabbi Yirmiyah of Difti said, he forgets his learning and adds folly, as it is said (Ecclesiastes 7:9), "for anger rests in the bosom of fools," and it is written (Proverbs 13:16), "but a fool spreads out folly." Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said, it is known that his sins are more numerous than his merits, as it is said (ibid. 29:22), "an angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in transgression" - to this point. And so they said in Berachot (29b): Eliyahu said to Rabbi Yehudah, brother of Rav Sala the Pious, do not become enraged and you shall not sin - and the reason is, "a wrathful man abounds in transgression."

And further we say in Pesachim (66b): Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said, every angry person - if he is a sage, his wisdom departs from him; if he is a prophet, his prophecy departs from him. If he is a sage, from where do we know this? From Moses, as it is written (Numbers 31:14), "and Moses was angry with the officers of the army," and so on, and it is written (ibid. 31:21), "and Elazar the priest said to the men of the army," and so on, "which the LORD commanded Moses" - implying that it had been hidden from Moses. And if he is a prophet, that his prophecy departs from him, from where do we know this? From Elisha, as it is written (II Kings 3:14), "were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you," and so on, "and now bring me a minstrel," and so on, "and the hand of the LORD came upon him," and so on.

Rabbi Mani bar Patish said, every angry person - even if greatness is decreed for him from Heaven, he is brought down - from where do we know this? From Eliav, as it is said (I Samuel 17:28), "and Eliav's anger was kindled against David, and he said, why have you come down, and with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the wickedness of your heart, for you came down to see the battle." And when Samuel went to anoint them, of all of them it is written, "the LORD has not chosen this one," but of Eliav it is written (I Samuel 16:7), "do not look at his appearance or the height of his stature, for I have rejected him" - implying that until now He had favored him - to this point.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Humility 2:43-5: And further they said in Vayikra Rabbah (13:1): Rav Huna said, in three places Moses became angry and a halachah was hidden from him, and these are they: on the Sabbath, concerning an onen [mourner before burial], and concerning metal vessels. On the Sabbath, as it is written (Exodus 16:20), "and some men left over from it" - once he became angry, the laws of the Sabbath were hidden from him; what did he say to them? (ibid. 16:25), "eat it today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD," and so on. And concerning metal vessels, "and Moses was angry with the officers of the army" (Numbers 31:14), and once he became angry, a halachah was hidden from him and he forgot to state the laws of metal vessels, until Elazar stated them. Concerning an onen, from where? (Leviticus 10:16), "and he was angry with Elazar and Itamar," and so on, and he forgot to tell them that an onen is forbidden to eat of the remaining sacred offerings - to this point. And they said in the Midrash HaShkem [an early midrash collection] concerning this matter: and if Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, of whom it is written (Numbers 12:7), "he is faithful in all My house," who conducted himself mercifully with Israel and gave his own life for them, saying (Exodus 32:32), "and if not, blot me out," and so on - father of the wise and the prophets - when he became angry for one hour, a halachah was hidden from him, how much more so ordinary people.

And the reason for all these punishments, besides the reason already explained - that anger comes from the side of pride, and therefore what applies to one applies closely to the other - is further explained by Rashbi, peace be upon him, in the Zohar (Parashat Tetzaveh, page 182a), from which the reason shall become clearer. He said there, on the verse (Isaiah 2:22), "cease from man, in whose nostrils is breath" - these are its words: and when the Holy One, blessed be He, created man, He made him in a supernal image, and breathed into him a holy spirit that includes three, as we have established, that he has nefesh, ru'ach, neshamah - and above all is neshamah, which is a supernal power to know and guard the commandments of the Holy One, blessed be He; and if that holy neshamah is brought into another service, this defiles it and it departs from the service of its Master, because these three powers are all one - nefesh, ru'ach, neshamah - joined together and becoming one, all in the pattern of the supernal secret, in accordance with what is said (Proverbs 13:20), "he who walks with the wise shall become wise." And if we see this person, in whom all these levels were found, before it is established with certainty who he is - by what is it known, when approaching this person, whether to withhold oneself from him? By his very anger one shall know him and recognize who he is - if he guards that holy neshamah at the time of his anger, so as not to uproot it from its place, so that a foreign god come to rest beneath it - behold, this is a person properly, this is a servant of his Master, this is a perfect man. But if that person does not guard it, and uproots this supernal holiness from its place so that the Other Side comes to rest in its place - certainly this is a person who rebels against his Master, and it is forbidden to draw near him or associate with him - and this is "he tears his own soul in his anger" - in his anger he tears and uproots his own soul because of his rage, and a foreign god comes to dwell within it.

And therefore it is written, "cease from man, in whose nostrils is breath [neshamah]" - for he tears that holy neshamah and defiles it because of his nose [anger] - "in whose nostrils" he exchanges it because of his nose. "For what is he accounted?" He is accounted as idolatry - and whoever associates with him and converses with him is as though he associates with idolatry itself. Why? Because idolatry itself dwells within him, and moreover, he has uprooted supernal holiness from its place and settled in its place idolatry, a foreign god - just as of a foreign god it is written (Leviticus 19:4), "do not turn to the idols," in this manner it is forbidden to gaze upon his face.

And if you say, but there is anger for the sake of Torah scholarship? The anger of Torah scholars is good in every way, for we have learned that Torah is fire, and Torah boils him - as it is written (Jeremiah 23:29), "are not My words like fire, says the LORD" - the anger of Torah scholars is over matters of Torah, the anger of Torah scholars is to give honor to Torah, and it is all for the service of the Holy One, blessed be He. But if it is over other matters, this is not the service of the Holy One, blessed be He - for in all the sins a person commits, it is not idolatry itself, and it is forbidden to draw near him for this.

And if you say, but this was only for a moment, and he transgressed and then returned - not so, for since he has uprooted the holiness of his soul from him and from its place, and that foreign god has strengthened itself within him and does not let him go - except if the person comes entirely and uproots it forever, and afterward strives to sanctify himself and draw holiness upon himself - only then, would that he be sanctified.

Rabbi Yosei said to him, is he actually sanctified [immediately]? He said to him, come and see, at the time he uproots the holiness of his soul and the foreign god settles in its place, the person becomes impure and is called impure, and defiles whoever draws near him, and that holiness has fled from him - and since it has fled from him once, how much must a person do until it returns to its place? He said to him, if so, how impure are they who [nonetheless] become pure again? He said to him, this impurity differs from other impurity, which he cannot avoid causing, but this differs entirely from everything: it defiles the body within and without, and the soul, and defiles everything, whereas the rest of the impurity in the world affects only the body from without alone - and therefore, "cease from man, in whose nostrils is breath," for he exchanged the holiness of his Master because of his nose - and this is the impurity that defiles everything - "for what is he accounted?" - as idolatry, certainly he is accounted.

Come and see, this anger is itself idolatry, the Other Side, as I have said, from which a person must guard himself and separate himself - and therefore it is written (Exodus 34:17), "you shall not make yourself a molten god" - "for yourself," to bring harm upon yourself - and it is written after it (ibid. 23:18), "you shall keep the feast of matzot" - this is the side of holiness that a person must guard, and not exchange it for the Other Side - and if he exchanges it, he becomes impure and defiles everyone who draws near him. "You shall keep the feast of matzot" - this is a place called "guard" [shamor], and therefore it is written, "you shall keep [tishmor] the feast of matzot" - to this point.

And when a person contemplates what Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained in this teaching, that the angry person uproots all the holiness within him, which are nefesh, ru'ach, and neshamah, and because these three are one bond, Scripture calls them "his soul" [nafsho] - "he tears his own soul," and so on, and this is what it means, that the three powers are all one. And Rashbi, peace be upon him, informed us in this teaching of the greatness of the punishment, that we should not say the blemish is only in the nefesh alone but not in the others - for this is not so, but rather all the holiness within him departs, since once the husk rests in him, holiness flees, for he brings in and gives dominion to the maidservant in place of her mistress - since this is actually the sin of idolatry, and resembles the sin of idolatry that Israel committed when they brought an image into the Sanctuary, causing the Shechinah to flee from there, as is known.

And therefore, since a foreign god, which is idolatry, comes to rest within him in a manner that defiles his body and soul, it is just that he forget his learning - for forgetting is the husk, as it is said (Genesis 40:23), "and the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him."

"And the Shechinah is not considered important compared to him" - as explained at the end of this teaching, concerning "you shall keep the feast of matzot - this is the side of holiness." And the matter is that "God has made this corresponding to that" (Ecclesiastes 7:14): just as the Shechinah is the inclusion of all the supernal attributes, and through her the arousal and dominion of the Cause of All Causes are shown, as explained in the Gate of Fear, chapter 1 - so too the foreign god, who is opposite her, includes within him all the powers of impurity, and he denies [divine] providence, as we explained in the Gate of Fear, chapter 8 - and therefore it said "all kinds of Gehinnom," for all of them are drawn from this husk, and all the other punishments are explained by this.

Now, the Shechinah rests only upon a broken and crushed heart, and since he is angry, his heart is proud against him, and immediately the foreign god rests upon him, and he is the sum of all impurity - and therefore it said, it is forbidden to associate with him, because the worship of idolatry is called "sacrifices of the dead," and offerings to idolatry defile either by carrying or by [being in the same] tent, according to Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira, as they said in Tractate Chullin, first chapter (13a), concerning the slaughtering of a non-Jew - it is [like] a carcass, and defiles by carrying - they said there, it is taught, Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira says, from where do we know that an offering to idolatry defiles by [being in the same] tent? As it is said (Psalms 106:28), "and they attached themselves to Baal Peor and ate the sacrifices of the dead" - just as a corpse defiles by tent, so an offering to idolatry defiles by tent - to this point.

And I heard from the mouth of Moreinu HaRav Yitzchak Ashkenazi, peace be upon him, that "he tears his own soul" means that he makes it a treifah [an animal with a fatal defect]. And one can be precise about this explanation from the language of the Zohar, which said, "that holy neshamah he tears and defiles because of his nose" - and its saying "defiles it," since it is a treifah, and a treifah is called dead, since a torn animal does not live twelve months (Chullin 57b), certainly it defiles - so too the angry person: since his holy soul was dwelling in his heart, once he brings in the husk, it is an adhesion that clings to it and defiles the soul. And so it says below, "and the soul, and everything, it defiles" - and it is not like an animal that is a treifah, which does not defile if it was slaughtered with a fit knife, but here he makes it a carcass [nevelah], slaughtering the soul with a blemished knife, which is Samael, SaM [poison] El [god], a foreign [zar] god.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Humility 2:55-3: And one can also be precise about this explanation from the language of the Zohar, which said, "this is called 'he tears his own soul in his anger,' he tears and uproots his soul because of his rage" - and it said "uproots," meaning "uprooting the signs" [ikur hasimanim], which is one of the five things that invalidate ritual slaughter, making the animal a carcass and defiling by carrying - and just as "uprooting the signs" is uprooting the thing not in the customary order, but rather outside of nature, so is the angry person: for the essence of holiness naturally dwells in a person, since he was created for this, and this person, against its will, uproots it from its place. It follows that the word "tearing" has two explanations, and both are true.

And it follows, along these lines, that the angry person, if he is a Kohen, makes himself impure with the impurity of a corpse - for all souls are from the side of Abraham, called "Kohen," as explained in Parashat Mishpatim (page 95a), that "the daughter of a Kohen" is the daughter of Abraham - and since he becomes angry, he kills his own soul, and the dead defile - it follows that a Kohen becomes defiled with the impurity of a corpse.

Further, a warning to the angry person is found written in the verse (Psalms 81:10), "there shall be no foreign god within you," and so on - and it is explained in Tractate Shabbat (105b): Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar in the name of Rabbi Chalafta ben Agra, who said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri: one who tears his garments in his rage, or breaks vessels in his rage, or scatters his money in his rage, shall be in your eyes like one who worships idolatry - for such is the craft of the evil inclination: today it tells him, do such-and-such, and tomorrow it tells him, go worship idolatry, and he goes and worships. And Rabbi Yochanan said, what is the verse? "There shall be no foreign god within you" - what is the "foreign god" that is within a person's own body? This is the evil inclination - to this point.

And in the Zohar (Parashat Pekudei, page 263b), in the First Chamber of the Chambers of Impurity, they said - these are their words: and above these there is one appointed one named Sfasirita, and several treasurers of accounts, and this appointed one over them receives these evil words - and likewise he receives all those things a person throws with his hands when rage rests upon him, for then this appointed one, Sfasirita, takes that word a person casts in his rage, and ascends and says, this is the offering of so-and-so, brought to our side - because every side of tranquility is from the side of the right and from the side of faith, and every side of rage is from the Other Side, the evil side, the impure side - and therefore, whoever throws something from his hand in rage, all these take that thrown thing and raise it above and bring it near to that side, and they say, this is the offering of so-and-so - and a herald calls out through all those firmaments and says, woe to so-and-so, who has strayed after a foreign god and worshiped another god - and the herald calls out a second time and says (Hosea 6:12), "woe to them, for they have strayed from Me," and so on. Happy is the person who guards his ways and does not stray to the right or to the left, and does not fall into a deep pit from which he cannot rise - to this point.

And through this teaching, Rashbi's teaching that we copied above, that "you shall keep the feast of matzot - this is the side of holiness," is explained more fully, and the language of guarding [shemirah] is mentioned in it, as explained above. And it is the Shechinah, called "matzah," which has no admixture of leaven, which are the husks, and is called "the feast of matzot" in her aspect on the right, which is Abraham, "Passover of the right arm" (Zohar, Parashat Ki Teitzei, page 282b) - and therefore Rashbi said, "every side of tranquility is from the side of the right and from the side of faith" - this is the secret of Israel's own craft, bound entirely to the Shechinah, as explained in the Gate of Fear, chapter 1 - and from the side of the right, as explained, whoever is not angry does not include himself on the side of judgment, while the angry person arouses the bile, which is the root of judgment, and therefore all kinds of Gehinnom rule over him, because he arouses judgment from its root, as it is written (Daniel 7:9-10), "a river of fire flowed and came forth from before Him" - and in the nose of Ze'ir [Anpin] there is a root for judgment, as it is written (Deuteronomy 32:22), "for a fire is kindled in My nose and burns to the depths of Sheol" - and the place where the river of fire is poured is in Gehinnom, "it shall whirl upon the head of the wicked," as explained in the Gate of Fear, chapter 13 - and therefore they said in the Tikkunim (page 85a) that the angry person is as though he kindled the fire of Gehinnom - these are its words, in Tikkun 48: happy is he who guards a fitting dwelling for the Sabbath, which is the heart, so that the sadness of the spleen and the anger of the bile, which is the fire of Gehinnom, not draw near there - of which it is said (Exodus 35:3), "you shall not kindle fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day" - and this is certainly so, for whoever becomes angry is as though he kindled the fire of Gehinnom - to this point. And in the Ra'aya Meheimna (page 234, beginning of column 2) they explained this matter further; see there.

And when we are precise about the teaching that said, "and this appointed one over them receives these evil words, and likewise receives," and so on - these are two matters: "evil words" are the bad things said in anger, which a person casts suddenly from his mouth, for this appointed one is appointed only over anger, since over all matters of vulgarity another appointed one has already been mentioned above, and likewise over slander, mentioned below in the Third Chamber, and so on - and likewise he is appointed over things thrown from a person's hand, and this is the meaning of "and likewise receives" - for if these are similar matters, it would be fitting to say "and likewise" - so it appears to me. It follows that the blemish of anger is in the First Chamber of the husk, because he has blemished the mistress and enthroned the maidservant, who shall take her vengeance upon him.

And it is explained in the Zohar (Parashat Tazria, page 43a) that once a person throws something from his hand in anger, from that hour he is handed over into the hand of the husk, and there is no blessing in the work of his hands - these are its words: come and see, it is forbidden for a person to throw the vessels of his house and consign them to the Other Side unnecessarily, or another similar matter, for several treasurers of accounts are ready for that thing to receive it, and from that time blessings do not rest upon him, since it is from the Other Side - and all the more so one who consigns his own supernal goodness to another, to the Other Side, for it belongs to whoever he consigned it to; and when a person's days draw near for him to leave this world, that supernal image given to him - that spirit that had attached to him every day comes, takes it, and it is repaired within it, and it goes its own way, and it never returns to the person again - then he shall know that he has been rejected from everything - to this point.

And after we have spoken of the punishments of pride and anger, let us come to explain in a chapter of its own what things a person should consider in his mind so that he not come to anger, and so that he not respond to his own disgrace:

The things a person should take to heart so that he not become angry are these. The first is what they, of blessed memory, explained (Pesachim 113b), and likewise in Chuppat Eliyahu (Gate of the Three): three the Holy One, blessed be He, loves: whoever is not angry, whoever does not become drunk, and whoever does not insist on his own rights - to this point. And the reason the Holy One, blessed be He, loves them is that these three are a chariot for Chesed, called love, as it is written (Jeremiah 31:3), "and I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with kindness [chesed]."

"Whoever is not angry" - it has already been explained above that the angry person arouses the power of the bile, which is the root of judgment, and it follows that he distances himself from Chesed. And likewise, one who becomes drunk is from the side of judgment, from the side of the harsh wine, from which love is not aroused - and whoever does not become drunk does not enjoy from the wine, which is judgment, but rather from what is close to arousing the love of Chesed, and therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, loves him. And likewise, whoever does not insist on his own rights is bound to Chesed, who does good both to the good and the wicked, since the Holy One, blessed be He, from the side of Chesed, does not repay a person according to his deeds, as it is written (Psalms 103:8-10), "the LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abundant in kindness; He will not always contend, nor keep His anger forever; He has not dealt with us according to our sins," and so on. And whoever insists on his own rights, deserving to be repaid measure for measure, is bound from the side of judgment, which is exacting, to give to each man according to his ways and the fruit of his deeds. And these three are the three lines in their order, from the side of prevailing Chesed.

And the merits that one who does not insist on his own rights has are these: first, that he lives long in this world; further, that his transgressions are forgiven, as we learn in Tractate Megillah (28a) - Rabbi Akiva asked Rabbi Nechunya the Great, through what have you lived long? He said to him, in my days I never accepted gifts, never insisted on my own rights, and was yielding with my money. This is like Rabbi Elazar, who, when they would send him gifts from the Nasi's house, would not accept them, and when they would invite him, would not go, saying to them, you do not wish that I live, for it is written (Proverbs 15:27), "and he who hates gifts shall live." Rabbi Zeira, when they would send to him from the Nasi's house, would not take, but when they would invite him, would go, saying, they honor themselves through me. "And never insisted on my own rights" - for Rava said, whoever does not insist on his own rights has all his transgressions forgiven, as it is said, "who bears iniquity and passes over transgression" - for whom does He bear iniquity? For whoever passes over transgression - to this point. And Rashi, of blessed memory, explained on this saying in Tractate Rosh Hashanah (17a): "one who does not insist on his own rights" - who does not exact measure for measure from those who trouble him, but rather sets aside his rights and moves on, like [the principle], "one does not [make a fuss and] pass over other mitzvot [to fulfill this one]," "one does not pass over foods [worrying over each]" - he sets them aside and moves on. "His transgressions are passed over for him" - the attribute of judgment does not scrutinize them, but rather sets them aside and moves on.

And further they said in Sanhedrin (92a) - these are their own words: and Rabbi Elazar said, always be among the humbled and sustained [i.e. accept humiliation and you shall endure] - meaning, be lowly and you shall live; and certainly whoever is lowly is humble and does not insist on his own rights.
